claim_text: HSC -> NKP -> immature NK -> mature NK
primary_source_pmid: 11433387 (Rosmaraki 2001, DOI 10.1002/1521-4141(200106)31:6<1900::AID-IMMU1900>3.0.CO;2-M — original NKP definition, FULL TEXT UNOBTAINABLE); 21931117 / PMC3217348 (Fathman 2011, DOI 10.1182/blood-2011-04-348912 — strongest primary evidence, full methods read); 12006976 (Kim/Yokoyama 2002, DOI 10.1038/ni796 — iNK->mNK staging, paywalled); 19234143 (Chiossone 2009, DOI 10.1182/blood-2008-10-187179 — 4-stage maturation, paywalled); 16606675 / PMC2118285 (Freud 2006, DOI 10.1084/jem.20052507 — human stage 1-4, full methods read); 26287684 (Renoux 2015, DOI 10.1016/j.immuni.2015.07.011 — human NKP, abstract only); 21422472 (Carotta 2011, pre-pro-NK, abstract only)
species: both (mouse = primary evidence chain; human = separate, weaker evidence chain; rhesus macaque appears only in counter-evidence)
what_was_measured: MOUSE (Fathman 2011, strongest link): in adult C57Bl/Ka CD45.1 mice, bone marrow Lin-CD27+CD244+Flk2- cells were split by 12-colour FACS into rNKP (CD122+) and pre-NKP (CD122-IL-7Ra+), sorted to >95% purity; (i) single cells were clone-sorted one per well into 96-well OP9 stromal cocultures and scored at day 10 for surface NKp46 (54+/-5% of rNKP wells, 40+/-2% of pre-NKP wells positive; 1 of 3 experiments); (ii) 300 sorted rNKP or pre-NKP were injected into UNCONDITIONED Rag2-/-Il2rgc-/- CD45.2 hosts and donor CD45.1 NKp46+ NK cells with a Ly49 repertoire plus ex vivo degranulation were enumerated at day 21; (iii) the same progenitors were injected intrathymically and read out at day 10 (no NK generated). MOUSE (Rosmaraki 2001, the NKP-defining paper): readout was flow-cytometric phenotype of Lin-CD122+NK1.1-DX5-Ly49- BM cells, RT-PCR for pTa/lambda5/CD3e vs IL-15Ra/Id2/GATA-3/Ets-1, 51Cr cytotoxicity of the freshly sorted population, and stromal/cytokine culture scored for outgrowth of lytic NK1.1+ cells with parallel T/B/myeloid/erythroid readouts — reported single-cell frequency on OP9 was 1/12 (this frequency quoted verbatim from Fathman 2011's Discussion, since Rosmaraki's own Methods are inaccessible). MOUSE (Kim 2002 / Chiossone 2009, the iNK->mNK link): BrdU incorporation and phenotypic ordering of CD11b/CD27/Ly49/CD94 subsets, diphtheria-toxin-induced NK ablation in NDE transgenic mice with EGFP+ recovery kinetics, microarray transcriptome proximity, and adoptive transfer of sorted EGFP+ NK subsets into unirradiated congenic recipients. HUMAN (Freud 2006): CD3-/CD19-depleted mononuclear cells from >50 tonsil and 30 lymph-node donors were sorted to >99% purity into stage 1 (CD34+CD45RA+CD117-CD94-), 2 (CD34+CD45RA+CD117+CD94-), 3 (CD34-CD117+CD94-) and 4 (CD34-CD117+/-CD94+); readouts were surface phenotype, real-time PCR for CD122/ETS-1/GATA-3/T-BET, luciferase cytotoxicity vs K562/Jurkat, IFN-g/GM-CSF/TNF-a/IL-13 ELISA, 2-5 week cultures on MS-5 or OP9-DL1 stroma with IL-15 +/- FL/IL-3/IL-7, CFU assays, and limiting dilution at 50/25/12.5/6.25/3.125/1.5625 cells per well x 10 replicates.
n: Fathman 2011: 5 recipient mice per progenitor type per experiment, 3 independent experiments (~15 recipients per arm); 300 sorted pre-NKP or rNKP injected per recipient; clonal assay = 1 cell/well in 96-well OP9 plates, 1 of 3 experiments shown, exact well totals not stated in Methods. Freud 2006: >50 tonsil donors plus 30 lymph-node donors (cells from multiple tonsil pieces/LNs POOLED per donor); limiting dilution 10 replicate wells per dose. Wang 2024 (Eomes-hi NK-neg): 400-800 sorted BM precursors per recipient into sub-lethally irradiated (450 rad) Rag2-/-Il2rg-/- mice, analysed 2 weeks post-transfer; competitive transfers used 500 cells pooled from 3-5 donor mice. Rosmaraki 2001: n NOT RECOVERABLE — full text inaccessible; do not assume a number.
n_unit: recipient animals (mouse, Fathman/Wang); donors (human, Freud — pooled tissue per donor); wells (clonal/limiting-dilution in vitro assays). NOT cells.
controls: Fathman 2011 (good): parallel transplantation of 1000 CLP and 10,000 unfractionated BM cells as reference populations; congenic CD45.1/CD45.2 donor tracking; hosts deliberately UNCONDITIONED — "We decided to use unconditioned animals in subsequent studies because irradiated animals are known to up-regulate factors" — which removes the irradiation-artefact confound; sorted purity >95%; intrathymic sham injections used PBS alone; ex vivo degranulation to confirm functional maturity. Freud 2006 (moderate): peripheral-blood CD34+ HPC, cord-blood CD34+ cells and PB CD56bright NK as reference populations; isotype-matched control mAbs; CD3/CD19 negative-selection controls; unseeded wells as blanks in limiting dilution; parallel CFU (myeloid), OP9-DL1 (T) and DC-medium cultures as negative-lineage-potential controls; EGTA/MgCl2 and anti-TRAIL/anti-FasL blocking in cytotoxicity. Rosmaraki 2001 (reported, unverifiable): T, B, myeloid and erythroid differentiation conditions run in parallel as negative-potential controls, and mature NK subsets as positive comparators — taken from the abstract, NOT from methods I could read. Kim 2002 / Chiossone 2009: congenic markers and unirradiated recipients; details unverifiable (paywalled). Notable MISSING control across the whole claim: no experiment excludes selection/expansion of a minority pre-committed cell inside the sorted gate, because no clonal barcode or genetic lineage tag was carried through the transfer.
evidence_types_all: OBS_TRANSFER; OBS_GENETIC; INF_INVITRO; INF_MARKER; INF_KINETIC; INF_TRAJECTORY
strongest_alternative_explanation: SELECTION/EXPANSION OF A PRE-EXISTING MINORITY, NOT CONVERSION OF THE GATED POPULATION. Every step of this chain is established by transferring or culturing a BULK, FACS-gated population and recovering NK cells downstream; no experiment tags an individual NKP and watches it become an NK cell. The gates are demonstrably impure: the founding NKP definition converted at only 1/12 at the single-cell level (Fathman 2011 Discussion, of Rosmaraki's NKP), and even the 6-fold-refined pre-NKP/rNKP convert at only 40-54% — so at minimum half of every "NKP" ever transferred is something else. Wang 2024 (Nat Immunol) states outright that "previously proposed NK cell precursors, including pre-NKPs and rNKPs, were contaminated with PLZF+ ILCPs." Both assay formats independently favour the selection reading: OP9 stromal coculture is known to expose cryptic, non-physiological lineage potentials (Ehrlich 2011, "stromal cocultures reveal cryptic, but nonphysiologic, myeloid potentials of lymphoid progenitors"), and transfer into an empty Rag2-/-Il2rgc-/- host imposes a strong lymphopenia-driven proliferative filter that will amplify whichever pre-committed contaminant is present. A second, non-exclusive alternative is MULTIPLE INDEPENDENT ORIGINS: Fathman's own intrathymic injections generated no NK cells, "suggesting a separate origin of thymic NK cells," Sojka 2014 identifies at least four distinct NK lineages (cNK, thymic, liver/skin trNK, uterine trNK), and macaque barcoding shows steady-state mature NK compartments are maintained by peripheral self-renewal rather than by flux through an upstream progenitor. A third is TECHNICAL: the human arm rests on marker overlap and culture only, and Freud's own Discussion concedes "stages 1-4 as we defined them are likely to be functionally heterogeneous... we cannot rule out these possibilities using the techniques we used in our study."
counter_evidence: [audit] 1) Wu C, Espinoza DA, Koelle SJ, ... Bryceson YT, Dunbar CE. Sci Immunol 2018;3:eaat9781. PMID 30389798 / PMC7393805 — barcoded autologous HSPC transplantation in rhesus macaques tracked >4 years: CD56-CD16+ NK clones "remained long-term clonally uncoupled from other hematopoietic lineages, including CD56+CD16- NK cells," and the authors conclude "linear NK cell production from multipotent hematopoietic progenitors or less mature CD56+CD16- cells is negligible during homeostasis and moderate proliferative stress." This is the highest-grade (clonal barcode, in vivo, primate) evidence in the whole area and it contradicts obligate linear flux. 2) Wu C, Li B, Lu R, ... Weissman I, Dunbar CE. Cell Stem Cell 2014;14:486-499. PMID 24702997 / PMC3979461 — "Clonal tracking of rhesus macaque hematopoiesis highlights a distinct lineage origin for natural killer cells." 3) Wang/Sun-lab, Nat Immunol 2024;25:1460-... PMID 38871999 / PMC11409033 — "We found that previously proposed NK cell precursors, including pre-NKPs and rNKPs, were contaminated with PLZF+ ILCPs"; proposes Eomes-hi NK-neg BM cells as the true cNK precursor, displacing the classical NKP node. 4) Ehrlich LIR, Serwold T, Weissman IL. Blood 2011;117:2618-2624. PMID 21163922 / PMC3062354 — "In vitro assays misrepresent in vivo lineage potentials of murine lymphoid progenitors"; a direct methodological indictment of the OP9 stromal assays that carry the NKP claim. 5) Xu W, Cherrier DE, ... Di Santo JP. Immunity 2019;50:1054-1068. PMID 30926235 / PMC6477155 — Id2-RFP reporter: "In contrast with the current model, we have demonstrated that Id2+Zbtb16+ ILCPs included multi-potent ILCPs that retained NK-cell potential" — from Di Santo's own lab, i.e. the NKP-defining group revising its own precursor map. 6) Sojka DK et al. eLife 2014;3:e01659. PMID 24714492 / PMC3975579 — "there are at least four distinct lineages of NK cells: cNK, thymic, liver (and skin) trNK, and uterine trNK cells." 7) Vosshenrich CAJ et al. Nat Immunol 2006;7:1217-1224. PMID 17013389 — thymic GATA-3+CD127+ NK pathway independent of the BM NKP (corroborated by Fathman's null intrathymic result). 8) Corat MA et al. Blood 2017;129:1940-1946 (PMID 27903532) and Schlums H et al. Blood 2017;129:1927-1939 (PMID 28209719) — in human PNH and GATA2 deficiency, adaptive NK cells persist long-term in patients depleted of stem and progenitor cells, i.e. mature NK maintenance uncoupled from HSPC input. || [adversarial] Seven items the audited row missed. The first two are the strongest and are direct demonstrations of the row's own "selection not conversion" alternative — which the auditor advanced as a reasoned possibility while apparently not knowing it had already been shown experimentally. 1) Ahn YO, Blazar BR, Miller JS, Verneris MR. Blood 2013;121:2234-2243. PMID 23327921. THE selection-not-conversion experiment for the human arm, and it is a failed conversion. Both IL-22-producing ILC22 cells and true cNK progenitors sit inside Freud's stage 3 gate: "Both have an immunophenotype corresponding to stage III NK progenitors (CD56+/-CD117high CD94-)." They are separable by LFA-1, and: "Most purified CD56+CD117+CD7+/-LFA-1- remained as ILC22 cells and never became cNK cells." Also: "In the absence of IL-15, CD34+ cells showed a complete block in cNK differentiation and instead gave rise to a CD56+ population of ILC22 cells." Freud's bulk stage-3 cultures appear to "mature into stage 4" because an LFA-1+ cNK-precursor minority already inside the gate is selected and expanded by IL-15. This is the canonical alternative, published, in the exact system, and absent from the row. 2) Crellin NK, Trifari S, Kaplan CD, Cupedo T, Spits H. J Exp Med 2010;207:281-290. PMID 20142432 (full text already sitting in this repo as /home/user/aaa/refs/D4_PMC2822607.txt, pulled for another claim). Two independent lineages inside the same gate: human tonsil CD127+RORC+ cells "constitute a stable RORC+ lineage distinct from conventional natural killer cells", they "can be expanded and cloned ex vivo without loss of function and without conversion into cNK cells", and Spits separately identifies a distinct cNK precursor, "Lin-CD117+CD161+CD127- cells". Independent-origins alternative, experimentally supported. 3) Hughes T, ..., Freud AG, ..., Caligiuri MA. Cell Rep 2014;8:150-162. PMID 24953655. The Freud/Caligiuri lab retracting the interpretation of its own stage 3: "This stage 3 population is heterogeneous, potentially composed of functionally distinct innate lymphoid cell (ILC) types that include interleukin-1 receptor (IL-1R1)-positive, IL-22-producing ILC3s. Whether human ILC3s are developmentally related to NK cells is a subject of ongoing investigation." And the transition it does document is lineage plasticity, not linear maturation: AHR antagonism "promotes the differentiation of tonsillar IL-22-producing IL-1R1hi human ILC3s to CD56bright CD94+ ... mature NK cells". The row cited Freud 2006 as the human backbone without recording that the same group reclassified stage 3 eight years later. 4) Nozad Charoudeh H, ..., Jacobsen SEW, Sitnicka E. Blood 2010;116:183-192. PMID 20421450. A single-cell in vivo refutation of the word "committed" in "committed NK progenitor", using the ORIGINAL Rosmaraki gate: "although Lin-CD122+NK1.1-DX5- NK-cell progenitors failed to commit to the B and myeloid lineages, they sustained a combined NK- and T-cell potential in vivo and in vitro at the single-cell level ... These findings demonstrate the existence of bipotent NK-/T-cell progenitors in adult BM." This is the assay Rosmaraki never ran, on Rosmaraki's own population, and it is negative for commitment. It is in Fathman 2011's own reference list, so it was one click from where the auditor was already reading. 5) Kouro T, Kumar V, Kincade PW. Blood 2002;100:3672-3680. PMID 12393656. The earliest published "the gate is a mixture" result in this exact lineage, one year after Rosmaraki: "single-cell experiments showed that the Lin- c-kit(Lo) fraction contains a mixture of B/NK, B-restricted, and NK-restricted progenitors", and it explicitly frames the obligate-intermediate question the claim assumes away: "it has not been clear if this is an obligate intermediate step for transit of multipotential hematopoietic stem cells to natural killer (NK) cells." 6) Gao Y et al. Nat Immunol 2017;18:1004-1015, PMID 28759001 (note: Author Correction exists, PMID 38514890), and Cortez VS et al. Nat Immunol 2017;18:995-1003, PMID 28759002. The terminal node is neither terminal nor unidirectional: mature NK cells convert into ILC1-like cells under TGF-beta / SMAD4 loss. A chain whose endpoint can exit the lineage is not a maturation ladder. 7) Blood Adv 2024, PMID 38484189 (already archived as D1_PMC11176970.txt, and the auditor read it, but only recorded its pseudotime component). Its clonal result also corrects the human chain structurally: it identifies "an ILC-restricted oligopotent stage 3a CD34-CD117+CD161+CD45RA+CD56- progenitor population, that exclusively gave rise to CD56-expressing ILCs in vitro", and finds "a previously nonappreciated heterogeneity within the CD56+CD94-NKp44+ subset, phenotypically equivalent to stage 3b population containing both group-1 ILC and RORgt+ ILC3 cells". Freud's stage 3 is at least three things.
downstream_dependency: (a) The Cd122-Cre (Il2rb-Cre) conditional-knockout driver is built directly on the premise that CD122+ NKP is THE committed NK intermediate — e.g. Theranostics 2023, PMID 37153735, "we deleted TOX at the hematopoietic stem cell stage (Vav-Cre), NK cell precursor (CD122-Cre) stage and late NK cell developmental stage (Ncr1-Cre)"; if the CD122+ gate is heterogeneous and contains PLZF+ ILCPs, the stage-attribution of every such conditional deletion is wrong. (b) The CD27/CD11b 4-stage schema is the primary phenotypic readout for NK-development genetics: Jaeger/Fehniger et al., Cell Rep 2020 (PMID 32492428) localise an Eomes requirement to "penultimately mature stage III NK cells," and Yang et al., eLife 2018 (PMID 29809146) localise Raptor to the CD27+CD11b- -> CD27+CD11b+ transition and Rictor to CD27+CD11b+ -> CD27-CD11b+ — both conclusions are re-readable as compartment-size shifts if the stages are not sequential. (c) Manufacturing: iPSC- and CD34+-derived NK cell therapy protocols are explicitly staged to walk cells NKP -> immature NK -> mature NK with sequential cytokine cocktails and use the stage markers as product release/identity criteria (e.g. the multiplexed iPSC-NK platform, PMID 40780202). (d) Clinically, Freud's human stage 1-4 framework is the standard scaffold for grading NK reconstitution after allogeneic HSCT and for characterising CAR-NK products — yet that framework has zero in vivo or transfer evidence behind it.
adversarial_revision: UPHELD. UPHELD at OBS_TRANSFER, but for partly different reasons than the auditor gave, and with four corrections — two against them, two in their favour. I re-pulled the primary source myself rather than trusting the row. `lit.py methods 21931117 --tag D1` returns STATUS=ABSTRACT_ONLY (the archived /home/user/aaa/refs/D1_PMC3217348.txt is 13,013 bytes of abstract + reference list, header line "# status=ABSTRACT_ONLY"), so I independently re-fetched PMC3217348 and pulled the Methods verbatim. The transfer is real and is correctly classed: "We injected as few as 300 rNKP or pre-NKP, 1000 CLP, or 10 000 unfractionated bone marrow cells from wild-type CD45.1 mice into unconditioned RAG2-/-IL2rgc-/- CD45.2 congenic hosts"; the clonal assay is explicitly in vitro ("We clone sorted rNKP and pre-NKP into 96-well plates and analyzed the wells on day 10"); and the fetch confirms "No barcoding, genetic lineage tracing, or single-cell (one cell per mouse) in vivo transfer experiments were performed in this study." So the auditor did NOT credit an OBS_* class to marker similarity, culture, or a trajectory. A transferred, B recovered = OBS_TRANSFER. Correct. CORRECTION 1 (against the auditor) — they overstated the absence of fate mapping, and thereby missed an OBS_DIRECT-class dataset. They wrote "no barcoding, live imaging or genetic clonal lineage tracing has ever followed a single NKP to a single mature NK cell". Narrowly true, but genetic lineage tracing HAS been applied to exactly this question and its verdict is exclusionary. I verified from PMC11409033's own Methods, verbatim: "irradiated recipients reconstituted with sorted YFP-Lin-Sca1+cKit+ precursors from PLZF(GFP-Cre)/+ROSA26(fl-STOP-fl-YFP)/+ mice, where YFP expression denotes cells derived from a PLZF-expressing precursor" (lethal 1,000 rad for the fate-mapping arm; 450 rad sub-lethal for the transfers). Constantinides 2014 Nature (PMID 24509713) is the same tool applied earlier: PLZF-high ILCP "excluded classical LTi and NK cells", and "Deletion of PLZF markedly altered the development of several ILC subsets, but not LTi or NK cells." So the field does own the OBS_DIRECT-class method, has run it on this node, and the result is that the classical precursor gates are a two-lineage mixture — not that NKP is a validated intermediate. Recording "no fate mapping exists" hides a negative fate-map result, which is worse than recording it. CORRECTION 2 (against the auditor) — G5 n error, and two archive claims that do not hold. The Methods say "Each progenitor type was injected into 5 individual mice per experiment. Data are representative of 1 of 5 experiments." The row states "3 independent experiments (~15 recipients per arm)". The paper says 5 experiments, not 3. Separately, the row asserts "Full Methods WERE obtained and archived for: Fathman 2011 (PMC3217348) ... Wang 2024 Eomes-hi NK-neg (PMC11409033)". Neither is archived: D1_PMC3217348.txt is abstract-only, and there is no D1_PMC11409033.txt in /home/user/aaa/refs/ at all. The quotes themselves are accurate — I re-verified both, including "We found that previously proposed NK cell precursors, including pre-NKPs and rNKPs, were contaminated with PLZF+ ILCPs, confirming previous reports" — so this is a provenance/bookkeeping failure, not fabrication. Their Freud quote also checks out: "1.5625 cells per well" occurs exactly once in D1_PMC2118285.txt, and ">50 tonsil and 30 LN donors" is verbatim. CORRECTION 3 (in the auditor's favour, against a possible UPGRADE) — I tested whether clonal barcoding UPGRADES arrow 1 (HSC to NK) to OBS_DIRECT, since the rubric lists barcoding under OBS_DIRECT and the auditor filed the macaque work only as counter-evidence. It does not. Wu 2014 Cell Stem Cell (PMID 24702997) reports that NK reconstitution "showed limited clonal overlap with T, B, or myeloid lineages, and therefore appears to be ontologically distinct", and Wu 2018 (PMID 30389798) that CD56-CD16+ clones "remained long-term clonally uncoupled from other hematopoietic lineages". The barcodes therefore do not demonstrate a shared multipotent-HSC clone giving rise to NK; they argue the opposite. I also checked the human equivalent — Nature 2024 HSC gene-therapy integration-site tracking across 53 patients (PMID 39442556) — and it reports myeloid/lymphoid/erythroid lineage output without an NK-specific clonal readout. No OBS_DIRECT supports this claim. OBS_TRANSFER stands as strongest. CORRECTION 4 (against the auditor, arrow-specific) — the iNK to mNK arrow has NO methods-verified transfer in either audit. Kim 2002 and Chiossone 2009 remain paywalled for both of us. I checked the paper most often substituted for them, Hayakawa & Smyth 2006 (PMID 16424180, archived D2_16424180.txt): by its own abstract it is a phenotype/function/tissue-distribution dissection ("CD27 is a key marker... dissecting the mature Mac-1high NK cell pool into two functionally distinct subsets"), i.e. INF_MARKER, with no transfer claimed. So on evidence I could actually read, arrow 3 is INF_MARKER + INF_KINETIC only. The row's OBS_TRANSFER credit for that arrow is inherited from an unread paper and should be flagged as unverified rather than asserted.
crossfield_g4_findings: The borrowed mechanism is not "NK differentiation" — it is HIERARCHY CONSTRUCTION: define a population by surface markers, transfer or culture it in bulk, recover a downstream cell type, and draw an arrow. That method has been audited to destruction in the myeloid/HSC, T-cell and ILC fields, and every audit landed on the alternative this claim cannot exclude. MYELOID / HSC FIELD — the identical textbook node dissolved under clonal resolution. - Perie L et al., Cell 2015 (PMID 26687356): "we use single-cell lineage tracing to demonstrate that so-called CMPs are highly heterogeneous with respect to cellular output, with most individual CMPs yielding either only erythrocytes or only myeloid cells after transplantation." The CMP — a node with far more supporting bulk-transfer data than NKP ever had — turned out to be a bag of already-committed cells. NKP is the same construction, the same assay, and has never had the same test. - Naik SH et al., Nature 2013 (PMID 23552896): indicts the assay class by name — the prior hierarchy "is based mainly on in vitro clonal assays and population-based tracking in vivo, which could miss in vivo single-cell complexity" — then shows by quantitative barcoding that "in vivo analysis of the output of sibling cells derived from single LMPPs shows that they often share a similar fate, suggesting that the fate of these progenitors was imprinted." Fate is imprinted BEFORE the gate. That is precisely "a pre-existing subset is selected, not converted", demonstrated with the method the NK field never applied. - Karamitros D et al., Nat Immunol 2018 (PMID 29167569): human LMPP/GMP/MLP are "functionally and transcriptionally distinct and heterogeneous at the clonal level ... most progenitors had the potential to develop into only one mature cell type ('uni-lineage potential')". MLP is the very compartment human NK potential is assigned to. Reinforced by Notta 2016 Science (PMID 26541609) and Velten 2017 Nat Cell Biol (PMID 28319093): the hierarchy is a continuum, and discrete nodes are gating artefacts. - Busch K et al., Nature 2015 (PMID 25686605) — the collision the NK field has never absorbed. Inducible HSC fate mapping in NATIVE, untransplanted mice: "transplantation imposes severe constraints on HSC engraftment", and there are "fundamental differences between the normal maintenance of the haematopoietic system, its regulation by challenge, and its re-establishment after transplantation"; adult haematopoiesis is "largely sustained by previously designated 'short-term' stem cells downstream of HSCs that nearly fully self-renew, and receive rare but polyclonal HSC input". Every experiment holding up D1 is a transplant into an emptied host. Those experiments measure regenerative potential under lymphopenic drive, not the steady-state route. This is exactly what the macaque barcoding independently reports for NK, and it means the two most-cited counter-findings and the mouse HSC field are saying the same thing. - Rieger MA et al., Science 2009 (PMID 19590005): the instruction-versus-selection question is formally the same question as conversion-versus-selection here, and the field records that it was undecidable by population assays — "Because of technical limitations, differentiation of individual HPCs could not previously be analyzed continuously. It was therefore disputed whether cell-extrinsic cytokines can instruct HPC lineage choice or only allow survival of cells that are already lineage-restricted." It was settled only by continuous long-term single-cell imaging. Hoppe PS et al., Nature 2016 (PMID 27411635) then used the same imaging to overturn a model built from snapshots. Bulk transfer plus stromal culture is, by the home field's own verdict, the wrong instrument for this question. - Weinreb C et al., Science 2020 (PMID 31974159) — decisive for G2: barcodes plus transcriptomes show "cells to have intrinsic fate biases not detectable by single-cell RNA sequencing", and the benchmark of trajectory tools shows "fate choice occurs earlier than is detected by state-of-the-art algorithms". This hits the current revision of the NK map as hard as the classical one: the PAGA/scVelo/TopicVelo ordering in PMID 38871999 and the Slingshot/scVelo ordering in PMC11176970 are exactly the algorithms shown to miss commitment that has already happened. T-CELL FIELD — the precedent for what a fate map does to a transfer-built lineage, in the same organ. - Schlenner SM et al., Immunity 2010 (PMID 20303297): "The view that T cells branch off from a lymphoid-restricted pathway has recently been challenged by a model proposing a common progenitor for T cell and myeloid lineages" — a model built on sorted-population transfer and OP9 culture. Il7r-Cre genetic fate mapping killed it: "Il7r fate mapping labeled all T cells but few myeloid cells ... the overwhelming majority of myeloid cells in the thymus were derived from Il7r reporter(-) cells." Same assay class, same tissue, opposite answer once lineage history rather than transferred potential was read out. Fathman 2011 cites this paper and Ehrlich 2011 (PMID 21163922, same lab, same year, "In vitro assays misrepresent in vivo lineage potentials of murine lymphoid progenitors") in its own reference list — the caveat was on the authors' desk. - Stemberger C et al., Immunity 2007 (PMID 18082432); Buchholz VR et al., Science 2013 (PMID 23493420); Gerlach C et al., Science 2013 (PMID 23493421). The T-cell field faced the identical "naive -> effector -> memory" linear-stage claim and set a concrete methodological bar: "transfer of a single antigen-specific naive T cell into a normal recipient mouse allowed recovery of clonally expanded daughter cells" — one cell, into a NORMAL (not lymphopenic) host. When done, population-level linearity turned out to mask "disparate individual fates". The NK field has never transferred a single NKP into anything, and every NKP transfer has been into an alymphoid host that imposes the exact proliferative filter single-cell transfer into normal hosts was designed to remove. ILC FIELD — the fate maps exist, and they cut against the node. - Constantinides MG et al., Nature 2014 (PMID 24509713): PLZF fate mapping and transfer define the ILCP, which "excluded classical LTi and NK cells"; PLZF deletion "markedly altered the development of several ILC subsets, but not LTi or NK cells". - Wang 2024 / Nat Immunol (PMID 38871999): applies that same PLZF-GFP-Cre x R26-YFP fate map directly to the NK precursor gates and reports, verbatim, "previously proposed NK cell precursors, including pre-NKPs and rNKPs, were contaminated with PLZF+ ILCPs, confirming previous reports." - Xu W et al., Immunity 2019 (PMID 30926235), from Di Santo's own lab — the group that defined the NKP: Id2-RFP reporter shows ILCPs retain NK potential, "in contrast with the current model". - Ghaedi M et al., J Exp Med 2020 (PMID 31816636): RORa tracer reveals tissue-local ILC progenitors, i.e. compartments not fed by the bone-marrow chain at all; consistent with Sojka 2014's four NK lineages and with Fathman's own null intrathymic result. - Plasticity closes the loop: Gao 2017 (PMID 28759001) and Cortez 2017 (PMID 28759002) show mature NK converting to ILC1-like cells. In the ILC field, "immature -> mature" arrows are routinely reversible or lateral; the D1 chain assumes unidirectionality that this field does not grant. NET: the home fields have already run the experiment the NK field is missing, three times over, and each time the FACS-gated intermediate turned out to be a mixture of pre-committed cells whose apparent conversion was selection under a transplant filter. The NK field's version of the claim has not been falsified — it has simply never been tested at the resolution that falsified all its neighbours.

strongest_alternative_explanation: The sorted "CD27+CD11b-" gate is not one precursor state but a mixture of lineages with different fates, so a BULK population transfer reads out selective survival/expansion of the cNK-biased fraction as if it were conversion (canonical alternative: a PRE-EXISTING subset is selected/expanded, plus two independent origins). This is not hypothetical — the one study with clonal resolution states it outright. Flommersfeld 2021 (verified, archived text): "we transferred low numbers of Ly49H+ ILC1-like or cNK cells into NKp46iCre x R26-LSL-iDTA or Rag2-/-Il2rg-/- mice and rested the transferred cells under homeostatic conditions for 2 or 3 weeks... Importantly, even without MCMV infection, no evidence for maturation of ILC1-like NK cells into the CD62L+ subsets was found, while CD27+CD62L+ NK cells further matured into CD27-CD62L+ cells." The ILC1-like branch inside the CD27+ gate is KLRG1-, CD11b-, Ly6C-, CD160+, transcriptionally overlapping ILC1 — i.e. it sits squarely in the claim's "CD27+CD11b-" stage and never progresses. Secondary alternatives: (a) CD27 and CD11b are environment/activation-regulated rather than an intrinsic clock — CD11b acquisition is monocyte- and IL-15-dependent (Soderquest 2011 Blood, PMID 21389319), so the "sequence" can be a signalling gradient read as a developmental order; (b) Chiossone's own supporting read-outs are equally consistent with differential proliferation — the paper itself reports that the CD11b-low subsets proliferate more, so faster appearance of later-gate cells after DT depletion is confounded by expansion rate, not conversion; (c) the microarray "global gene profile proximity" between subsets is expression-space adjacency and cannot distinguish "A becomes B" from "A and B are independent adjacent states" (G2 class).

This paper does not appear anywhere in the row's counter_evidence or searches_run. Its design is the direct control that every transfer supporting D2 lacks: KLRG1-negative WT CD45.1+ NK cells were transferred into lymphopenic Rag1-/- or Tcra-/- hosts versus WT hosts. Now look at the hosts in every transfer that survives G1 in this row: Gordon 2012 used Il2rg-/-Rag2-/- (no T, no B, no NK, and no cell able to consume IL-15 via the common gamma chain); Flommersfeld 2021 used Rag2-/-Il2rg-/-, Klra8-/-, or NKp46iCre x R26-LSL-iDTA. crossfield_g4_findings: The claim borrows a completely generic process — a surface-marker-defined linear differentiation series, inferred from bulk adoptive transfer into an emptied niche. Both of its markers, and both of its inferential moves, have known fatal collisions in the fields they came from. The row ran no cross-field search at all. 1. MYELOID FIELD — CD11b/Mac-1 is an activation readout, not a clock. Miller LJ, Bainton DF, Borregaard N, Springer TA, J Clin Invest 1987;80:535-544, PMID 3038962: Mac-1 (CD11b/CD18) and p150,95 are stored in an intracellular vesicular compartment and mobilized to the cell surface on stimulation. In the field that discovered this molecule, CD11b surface density is a minutes-scale degranulation readout. A "CD11b-low to CD11b-high" transition therefore requires no differentiation whatsoever, and is inducible by handling, temperature, chemoattractant, or cytokine during the tissue prep and stain. That is the x-axis of the plot on which this entire claim is drawn, and it is a translocation assay in its home field. It also explains Flommersfeld's result that ALL infection-driven clones went CD11b+ regardless of fate. 2. MYELOID FIELD — the exactly homologous claim was overturned, by exactly the method never applied here. "Blood monocytes become tissue macrophages" was held for decades on marker overlap plus transfer into irradiated/lymphopenic recipients — the same evidence structure as D2. Genetic fate mapping and parabiosis destroyed it: Schulz C et al., Science 2012;336:86-90, PMID 22442384 (a Myb-independent lineage of macrophages arising independently of HSCs); Gomez Perdiguero E et al., Nature 2015;518:547-551, PMID 25470051 (tissue-resident macrophages from yolk-sac erythro-myeloid progenitors). The transfers had "worked" precisely BECAUSE the niche had been emptied. The control case is just as instructive: Yona S et al., Immunity 2013;38:79-91, PMID 23273845 confirmed the Ly6Chi -> Ly6Clo monocyte conversion, but only with an inducible Cx3cr1-CreER timestamp in an intact animal — not by transfer. That is the standard of proof D2 has never met, and my search for an equivalent inducible NK timestamp returned zero. 3. T CELL FIELD — transfer into a lymphopenic host manufactures the "mature" phenotype. Cho BK, Rao VP, Ge Q, Eisen HN, Chen J, J Exp Med 2000;192:549-556, PMID 10952724, "Homeostasis-stimulated proliferation drives naive T cells to differentiate directly into memory T cells": naive T cells transferred into a lymphopenic host convert to a memory surface phenotype through homeostatic proliferation alone, with no antigen and no genuine memory differentiation. This has been standard knowledge since 2000. Every transfer in this row whose methods survive G1 uses an Il2rg-/-Rag2-/- or NK-ablated host. The NK field then independently rediscovered the same artefact without connecting it to the staging model (Kamimura & Lanier 2015, PMID 25578733, above). The T cell field's fix was congenic transfer into intact hosts or in-situ fate mapping; Chiossone's unirradiated-host design is the one experiment in this literature that would have addressed it, and it is the one nobody can read. 4. T CELL FIELD — CD27 indexes stimulation history, not developmental age. CD27 is a TNFRSF costimulatory receptor whose surface level is governed by engagement with CD70 and which is shed as soluble CD27; Hendriks J et al., Nat Immunol 2000;1:433-440, PMID 11062504 established CD27/CD70 as the axis controlling T cell expansion and maintenance. In T cell immunology "CD27-low" is read as cumulative antigen/CD70 exposure, which is why CD27 loss is not monotonic with time and is reversed or prevented by altering CD70 availability. Importing CD27 into NK cells as a maturation clock imports a molecule that its home field reads as a ligand-driven state variable. This dovetails with Narni-Mancinelli's non-monotonic CD27 column and with the fact that step 2 of D2 is defined purely as loss of this molecule. 5. T CELL FIELD — "terminally differentiated" surface phenotypes are not terminal, and only an ex-marker fate map can see it. Herndler-Brandstetter D et al., Immunity 2018;48:716-729, PMID 29625895: "Using genetic fate mapping analysis of highly cytotoxic KLRG1+ effector CD8+ T cells, we demonstrated that KLRG1+ cells ... downregulated KLRG1 during the contraction phase in a Bach2-dependent manner and differentiated into all memory T cell lineages", generating "ExKLRG1" memory cells. The canonical terminal marker was reversible, and it took a KLRG1 fate-mapping reporter to find out — no transfer or kinetic study had. D2 asserts CD27-CD11b+ is the endpoint of a one-way sequence. No ex-CD11b or ex-CD27 NK reporter exists (searched, zero hits), so the terminal and directional half of D2 sits in exactly the blind spot that hid ExKLRG1 for fifteen years. Note KLRG1 is itself part of this very NK staging scheme. 6. T CELL FIELD — bulk ordering is not any individual cell's trajectory. Buchholz VR et al., Science 2013;340:630-635, PMID 23493420 ("Disparate individual fates compose robust CD8+ T cell immunity") and Gerlach C et al., Science 2013;340:635-639, PMID 23493421 ("Heterogeneous differentiation patterns of individual CD8+ T cells"): single-cell fate mapping showed that a smooth, reproducible population-level differentiation series is assembled from wildly heterogeneous single-cell fates, and that the population average corresponds to no actual cell. This is the formal reason a bulk CD27/CD11b transfer cannot license "A becomes B". Flommersfeld 2021 is the NK field's late arrival at this same result and it found the same thing — a heterogeneous head gate. 7. ILC FIELD — marker transitions of exactly this kind are cytokine rheostats, and IL-15 is the knob. Vonarbourg C et al., Immunity 2010;33:736-751, PMID 21093318: using adoptive transfer of genetically tagged LTi-like cells plus genetic lineage tracing, differentiation was "characterized by the stable upregulation of NKRs and a progressive loss of RORgt expression", and critically "IL-7 and intestinal microbiota stabilized RORgt expression within such NKR-LTi cells, IL-12 and IL-15 accelerated RORgt loss"; the authors call the marker gradient "a tunable rheostat for their functional program", not a developmental stage. Two direct consequences for D2. First, a marker-loss transition whose rate is set by IL-15 is precisely what D2's step 2 looks like, and the NK transfers were done in IL-15-flooded hosts. Second, this lineage ends up NK1.1+NKR+ and phenocopies NK cells — a marker-defined endpoint reached from an unrelated lineage, so occupancy of the CD27-CD11b+ gate does not identify a cell's history. The field's own caveat literature agrees (PMID 36052086, "Just one word, plastic!": most ILC plasticity and maturation claims rest on in vitro culture and transfer into alymphoid hosts and are not established in situ). NET: the myeloid field says the x-axis marker is a degranulation assay; the T cell field says the y-axis marker is a ligand-exposure assay; the T cell field says the transfer design manufactures the phenotype; the myeloid field says this exact evidence structure produced a famous wrong answer; the T cell field says bulk ordering is not a trajectory; and the ILC field says marker-loss transitions of this shape are IL-15-tunable rheostats. None of this is visible from NK keywords, and none of it is in the row.

what_was_measured: Chan 2007 (from abstract + Cichocki 2019's methods-level description; Methods themselves NOT read): in human healthy-adult peripheral blood, CD3-CD56brightCD16- and CD3-CD56dimCD16+ NK cells were prospectively FACS-sorted and then (a) co-cultured with primary human synovial fibroblasts +/- an FGFR1-blocking antibody, with surface CD56/CD16, intracellular perforin, IFN-gamma and K562 lysis read out by flow cytometry; a parallel cytokine-only condition (IL-2 + IL-15 + 721.221 cells) was run and did NOT induce the phenotype change; (b) sorted CD56bright cells were injected into NOD-SCID mice and, at day 10, surface CD56 and CD16 on recovered human cells were scored by flow cytometry in blood, spleen and lymph node ("almost uniformly CD56dimCD16+"); (c) telomere length was measured in freshly isolated CD56bright vs CD56dim by flow-cytometric FISH. Romagnani 2007 (abstract only): sorted human PB CD56brightCD16-KIR- NK cells were cultured with IL-2/IL-15/IL-12 and surface KIR, CD16 and CD56 were re-stained; flow-FISH telomere length was compared between PB CD56dim and PB/lymph-node CD56bright from donors; KIR and CD16 surface staining was compared across non-reactive lymph node, hyperplastic/reactive lymph node, efferent lymph and peripheral blood. Ouyang 2007 (abstract only): flow-FISH telomere fluorescence in CD56dimCD16+ vs CD56brightCD16- NK cells sorted from the same adult donor, across a donor age range. Domaica 2012 (Methods read in full): in ONE paediatric-to-adolescent patient with melanoma plus opportunistic fungal infection and in healthy adult controls, PBMC were stained for CD3/CD56/CD16/CD57/CD158/CD62L/perforin/NKp46/NKG2D/DNAM-1/2B4/CD94-NKG2A and analysed on a FACSAria, at baseline and after overnight IL-12+IL-15+IL-18 or 5-day IL-2/IL-15 culture, with intracellular IFN-gamma and surface CD107a as functional readouts.

Domaica 2012: initially age-matched healthy donors, later young-adult (25-30) healthy donors; paired t-test within donor between subsets. NOT CONTROLLED anywhere: the possibility that sorted "CD56bright" inocula carry contaminating CD56dim cells that are then selected/expanded; and the possibility that surface CD56 (NCAM1) density is an activation-state variable rather than a lineage mark.

strongest_alternative_explanation: A PRE-EXISTING CD56dim SUBSET IS SELECTED AND EXPANDED, NOT CONVERTED. CD56dim cells are ~90% of blood NK cells, so even a 1-2% CD56dim carry-over in a sorted CD56bright inoculum is, in absolute terms, a substantial CD56dim population. Over 10 days in a NOD-SCID xenograft — a severe survival bottleneck with no human IL-15 and no HLA-matched stroma — preferential survival/homeostatic expansion of that contaminant would reproduce the exact reported readout ("almost uniformly CD56dimCD16+ in blood, spleen and lymph node") with zero conversion of any cell. Chan 2007 used no clonal marking, so the design cannot distinguish conversion from selection, and I could not read the sort purity. The same alternative applies to the fibroblast co-culture arm (only "a fraction" of cells lost CD56) and, in the reverse direction, to Romagnani 2007, where KIR was induced on CD56dimKIR- cells as well — i.e. the "maturation markers" track activation, not lineage. SECOND ALTERNATIVE (technical/state, not lineage): surface CD56/NCAM1 density is a modulable activation-state variable, so "CD56bright becomes CD56dim" may be reversible phenotypic modulation of one population rather than an irreversible maturation step; note that Chan's fibroblast contact and Romagnani's cytokines gave OPPOSITE answers about whether cytokines drive the change, which Cichocki 2019 flags as an unexplained discrepancy. THIRD ALTERNATIVE (two independent origins): CD56bright and CD56dim are separately maintained lineages arising from distinct progenitors — now directly supported by clonal barcoding in macaques and by two-pathway (ENKP vs ILCP) NK ontogeny in mice. FOURTH (for the reconstitution-kinetics leg): post-HSCT CD56bright predominance at 1 month giving way to CD56dim by 3 months is equally explained by lymphopenia-driven homeostatic expansion of CD56bright followed by its normalisation — stated explicitly in Cichocki/Grzywacz/Miller Front Immunol 2019.
counter_evidence: [audit] 1) Wu C, Espinoza DA, Koelle SJ, ... Bryceson YT, Dunbar CE. "Clonal expansion and compartmentalized maintenance of rhesus macaque NK cell subsets." Sci Immunol 2018;3(29):eaat9781. PMID 30389798 / PMC7393805. Autologous transplant of lentivirally barcoded CD34+ HSPCs in 3 rhesus macaques; CD56+CD16- and CD56-CD16+ NK cells FACS-sorted to >98% purity; barcodes tracked 49-52 months. Verbatim: "the barcode composition of CD56+CD16- and CD56-CD16+ NK cells remained distinct under homeostatic conditions over several years"; "these biased clonal patterns are difficult to explain via continuous ongoing production of terminally-differentiated short-lived rhesus CD56-CD16+ NK cells from HSPC via maturation through CD56+CD16- NK cells"; abstract: "linear NK cell production from multipotent hematopoietic progenitors or less mature CD56+CD16- cells is negligible during homeostasis and moderate proliferative stress." "Mutations in GATA2 cause human NK cell deficiency with specific loss of the CD56bright subset." Blood 2013;121(14):2669-77. Macallan DC. Immunology 2007;121:258-65, PMID 17346281 — the human in vivo deuterated-glucose NK kinetics study — sorted CD3-CD16+ NK cells ONLY and did not resolve CD56bright vs CD56dim, so it supplies no bright-to-dim kinetic evidence despite being cited in that role. || [adversarial] THE BIG MISS — A REVERSE-DIRECTION CONVERSION EXPERIMENT, SAME AXIS, SAME EVIDENCE CLASS, PUBLISHED FIRST, WITH BETTER-DOCUMENTED PURITY THAN CHAN. Keskin DB, Allan DSJ, Rybalov B, Andzelm MM, Stern JNH, Kopcow HD, Koopman LA, Strominger JL. "TGFbeta promotes conversion of CD16+ peripheral blood NK cells into CD16- NK cells with similarities to decidual NK cells." Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 2007;104(9):3378-83. PMID 17360654 / PMC1805591. Published 27 Feb 2007 — BEFORE Romagnani (15 Apr 2007) and BEFORE Chan (1 Jul 2007). METHODS READ (WebFetch on PMC1805591), verbatim: CD16+ pNK cells were "sorted to very high purity (i.e., the contamination with CD16- pNK cells was <0.1%)"; cultured "for 2-3 weeks in 24-well plates (10^6 cells in 1 ml)" with "20 ng/ml IL-15, and 20 ng/ml SCF" plus TGF-beta1 (2 or 10 ng/ml) or decidual-stromal-cell conditioned medium; CD56+CD16- outgrowth seen in "12 of 16 independent experiments"; n=17 for the conditioned-medium TGF-beta1 measurements. Authors' verbatim conclusion: "The data are most consistent with a conversion of cells from CD16+ to CD16-, under the influence of TGFbeta, accompanied by proliferation." And on the other marker: "both culture conditions appeared to increase the intensity of CD56 staining." WHY THIS IS FATAL AND WHY THE AUDITOR'S "NOT FOUND" WAS WRONG. The auditor ran 'CD56dim NK cells give rise to CD56bright plasticity reverse', got 0 hits, and recorded the reverse-direction alternative as searched-and-not-found. It exists, it is 19 years old, and it is sitting in the reference list of Collins et al. Cell 2019 (PMID 30595449), which I pulled. Keskin is the SAME evidence class (INF_INVITRO), the SAME readout (surface CD56/CD16 on prospectively sorted subsets under a stromal-derived factor), and it is the ONE of the two that actually reports its sort purity (<0.1% contamination) and explicitly argues conversion over outgrowth of contaminants. Chan's purity is unknown to me and to the previous auditor. Consequence: the CD56/CD16 axis is a bidirectional, microenvironment-driven phenotype axis — FGFR1/fibroblast contact pushes one way, TGF-beta pushes the other — not a lineage arrow. Any experiment whose sole readout is CD56/CD16 surface density therefore cannot fix the direction of the arrow, and that includes Chan's NOD-SCID arm. SECOND MISS — CD56 BRIGHTNESS IS AN ACTIVATION-STATE VARIABLE, DOCUMENTED IN HUMANS BOTH WAYS. Van Acker HH, Capsomidis A, Smits EL, Van Tendeloo VF. "CD56 in the Immune System: More Than a Marker for Cytotoxicity?" Front Immunol 2017;8:892 (PMID 28791027). Read via WebFetch, verbatim: "Upon activation, CD56dim NK cells can adopt a CD56bright-like immunophenotype or upregulate their CD56 expression in general" (citing Garcia-Cuesta 2017, Richter 2013, Vukicevic 2010); "Upon DC vaccine-mediated activation, both CD56bright and CD56dim NK cell subsets upregulate their expression of CD56"; and, directly relevant to the xenograft readout, "NK cells exposed to an immunosuppressive milieu downregulate their CD56 expression, concomitant with abolition of their cytotoxicity" (citing Reiners 2013). A NOD-SCID host with no human IL-15 and no HLA-matched stroma is an immunosuppressive/starved milieu, so CD56 dimming there is an expected stress phenotype independent of any maturation. THIRD MISS — A HUMAN PRIMARY SHOWING BOTH DIRECTIONS MOVING IN THE SAME CULTURE. Garcia-Cuesta EM et al. "Characterization of a human anti-tumoral NK cell population expanded after BCG treatment of leukocytes." OncoImmunology 2017;6(4):e1293212. PMID 28507799 / PMC5414876. Abstract verbatim: "after BCG stimulation, CD56dim NK cells proliferate, upregulate CD56, but maintain the expression of CD16 and the ability to mediate ADCC. CD56bright NK cells also contribute to this expansion by increasing CD16 and KIR expression." Both subsets move along both markers under one stimulus — the axis is an activation readout. FOURTH — THE DECISIVE HUMAN EXPERIMENT HAS NEVER BEEN RUN, AND I VERIFIED THAT RATHER THAN ASSUMING IT. Six E et al. Blood 2020;135:1219-31 (PMID 32040546), vector-integration-site clonal tracking in Wiskott-Aldrich and beta-hemoglobinopathy gene-therapy patients, tracked five lineages "(granulocytes, monocytes, T cells, B cells, and natural killer cells)" — NK as ONE lineage, no CD56bright/CD56dim split (record read; archived text grepped for CD56/NK subset language, nothing). Ludwig LS et al. Cell 2019;176:1325 (PMID 30827679) established mtDNA-mutation lineage tracing in humans, i.e. the tool that could settle this now exists. It has not been applied to these two subsets. SEARCHED AND NOT FOUND — not nonexistent. I did NOT find a failed formal replication of the Chan NOD-SCID transfer; I searched for one and found nothing either way, which is itself the finding — Cichocki 2019 (verified verbatim in the archived PMC6727427): "it's somewhat surprising that no follow up studies looking deeper into the FGF signaling pathway and its role in driving NK cell maturation have been published." The auditor's existing counter-evidence (Wu 2018 macaque barcoding PMID 30389798; Mace 2013 GATA2 PMID 23365458; Ding 2024 PMID 38872000; Cichocki 2019 PMID 31555287) I re-checked and it stands. Add: Allan DSJ et al. Sci Rep 2017;7:3501 (PMID 28615725 / PMC5471261), "Transcriptome analysis reveals similarities between human blood CD3- CD56bright cells and mouse CD127+ innate lymphoid cells" — human CD56bright resemble helper ILCs rather than cytotoxic-NK precursors, an independent 2017 antecedent of the two-pathway model that the auditor did not cite.
downstream_dependency: 1) THE FREUD/CALIGIURI FIVE-STAGE HUMAN NK DEVELOPMENT MODEL. Stage 4 = CD56bright and Stage 5 = CD56dim; the stage-4-to-stage-5 arrow IS this claim. The model is the standard framework for staging human NK development in bone marrow, tonsil and lymph node (Freud AG et al. J Exp Med 2006;203:1033-43, PMID 16606675; Freud AG, Mundy-Bosse BL, Yu J, Caligiuri MA, Immunity 2017;47:820-33, PMID 29166586). 2) iPSC- AND CD34-DERIVED NK CELL PRODUCTS FOR ADOPTIVE IMMUNOTHERAPY. Current differentiation protocols yield predominantly CD56bright-phenotype cells, and the rationale that these will mature into cytotoxic CD56dim effectors in the patient rests on this claim. Cichocki/Grzywacz/Miller (Front Immunol 2019;10:2078) state the dependency explicitly: "It is possible that current culture systems which predominantly generate cells with a CD56bright phenotype favor the expansion/differentiation of a particular subset of precursor clones at the expense of other clones that differentiate into CD56dim NK cells." Named programmes in that lineage: the Miller/Cichocki (Univ. Minnesota) CD34-derived and Fate Therapeutics iPSC-NK (FT500/FT516) products. 3) INTERPRETATION OF POST-HSCT NK RECONSTITUTION. The CD56bright-then-CD56dim sequence after transplant is read as maturation rather than differential homeostatic expansion, and is used to time NK-based relapse prophylaxis and to judge "immune reconstitution quality". 4) THE "CD56bright = IMMATURE REGULATORY PRECURSOR" READING OF DACLIZUMAB IN MULTIPLE SCLEROSIS (Bielekova B et al. PNAS 2006;103:5941-6, PMID 16585503) and of CD56bright expansion in autoimmunity generally. 5) EVERY scRNA-seq PSEUDOTIME/VELOCITY PAPER THAT ROOTS ITS NK TRAJECTORY AT CD56bright AND ORIENTS IT TOWARD CD56dim BY ASSUMPTION — e.g. Yang C et al. Nat Commun 2019;10:3931 (PMID 31477722); Crinier et al. Immunity 2018; Cell Mol Immunol 2021;18:1290 (PMID 33239726, "trajectories of NK cell differentiation in bone marrow"); Front Immunol 2022 (PMID 36505452, "CD56dimGranzymeK+ subset as intermediate stage in NK cell differentiation"). These are INF_TRAJECTORY by rule G2 and they IMPORT the direction of the arrow from this claim rather than testing it — a circularity that makes the claim's failure propagate directly into their conclusions.

crossfield_g4_findings: THE BORROWED PROCESS: "a marker-defined, cytokine-producing subset is the obligate precursor of a marker-defined cytotoxic effector subset, inferred from marker overlap + longer telomeres + greater proliferative potential + adoptive transfer into a host." Three fields have already run this play, and two of them broke it. (A) T CELL FIELD — THE ARROW RAN BACKWARD ON EXACTLY THIS INFERENCE. Wherry EJ, Teichgraber V, Becker TC, Masopust D, Kaech SM, Antia R, von Andrian UH, Ahmed R. "Lineage relationship and protective immunity of memory CD8 T cell subsets." Nat Immunol 2003;4(3):225-34. PMID 12563257. (I read the PubMed record/abstract, archived at /home/user/aaa/refs/D3_12563257.txt; I did NOT read its Methods — Nat Immunol 2003 is not in PMC.) Verbatim from the record: "We also demonstrate that, following antigen clearance, T(EM) convert to T(CM)... We propose that T(CM) and T(EM) do not necessarily represent distinct subsets, but are part of a continuum in a linear naive --> effector --> T(EM) --> T(CM) differentiation pathway." CD62L/CCR7-defined Tcm were widely assumed to be the precursor of Tem on precisely the CD56bright logic — less-differentiated surface phenotype, longer telomeres, greater proliferative potential, lymph-node homing. Sorted-subset adoptive transfer showed the opposite. THE COLLISION: in the field where this inference pattern was tested hardest, "longer telomeres + more proliferative + LN-homing = the precursor" was WRONG about direction. Ouyang 2007 (PMID 17303822) and the telomere flow-FISH arms of Chan 2007 and Romagnani 2007 make identically-structured arguments and inherit the identical failure mode: shorter telomeres in CD56dim establish only that CD56dim have divided more, which two independently maintained lineages with different replicative histories also produce. Same field, same lesson from the other end: Herndler-Brandstetter et al. Immunity 2018;48:716 (PMID 29625895) — "KLRG1+ Effector CD8+ T Cells Lose KLRG1, Differentiate into All Memory T Cell Lineages" — a canonical "terminal differentiation" surface marker is reversible. (B) MYELOID FIELD — THIS EXACT QUESTION WAS SETTLED IN HUMANS WITH A TOOL NOBODY HAS APPLIED TO NK SUBSETS; AND SEPARATELY, TRANSFER-INTO-AN-EMPTY-HOST IS A KNOWN ARTEFACT GENERATOR. (i) THE STANDARD THAT WAS MET. Patel AA, Zhang Y, Fullerton JN, ..., Yona S. "The fate and lifespan of human monocyte subsets in steady state and systemic inflammation." J Exp Med 2017;214(7):1913-23. PMID 28606987 / PMC5502436 — MEHODS AND RESULTS READ (archived /home/user/aaa/refs/D3_PMC5502436.txt). Design in humans in vivo: a 3-h pulse of 6,6-2H2-glucose in healthy volunteers, then flow-SORTED classical/intermediate/nonclassical monocyte subsets at sequential timepoints, deuterium incorporation into DNA measured, fitted to an explicit compartment ODE model with a delay-vs-no-delay model comparison (Fig. S2, Table S1). Verbatim: "there was no deuterium labeling for the first 24 h after administration, consistent with a postmitotic 'maturation' phase preceding release from bone marrow into the circulation"; and crucially "we excluded models in which circulating subsets proliferate in the blood on the basis of (1) the absence of any deuterium enrichment in such cells 24 h after labeling and (2) the absence of markers of cell cycling." THAT is what an in-vivo human subset-lineage claim looks like when it is actually tested: a pulse-chase label, prospectively sorted subsets, and the competing selection/proliferation model explicitly excluded BY DATA. Nothing of this kind exists for CD56bright->CD56dim. The only NK deuterium study (Zhang 2007, PMID 17346281) sorted CD3-CD16+ only and did not resolve the subsets — the auditor got that right. My own search 'NK cell subsets deuterium in vivo labelling humans' returned zero. So the human label-chase test of this claim HAS NOT BEEN DONE, and the neighbouring field shows it is entirely doable. (ii) THE STRUCTURAL WARNING ABOUT NOD-SCID. Yona S et al. "Fate mapping reveals origins and dynamics of monocytes and tissue macrophages under homeostasis." Immunity 2013;38:79-91, PMID 23273845; Hashimoto D et al. "Tissue-resident macrophages self-maintain locally throughout adult life with minimal contribution from circulating monocytes." Immunity 2013;38:792-804, PMID 23601688. (Titles/records located via lit.py; I did NOT read their Methods.) Decades of adoptive-transfer and in-vitro-culture data "showed" that blood monocytes become tissue macrophages. Genetic fate mapping and parabiosis showed that at homeostasis they largely do not — the transfer experiments worked because the recipient niche had been emptied by irradiation. THE COLLISION: transfer into a vacant/lymphopenic niche is a documented manufacturer of differentiation routes that do not operate at homeostasis. Chan's arm is transfer of human cells into a profoundly lymphopenic xenogeneic host. And the NK field already has its own version of the myeloid resolution: Wu 2018 (PMID 30389798) reports barcode repertoires of CD56+CD16- and CD56-CD16+ macaque NK "remained distinct under homeostatic conditions over several years" with linear production "negligible" at homeostasis — homeostasis and transplant/stress give different answers, exactly as in the macrophage story. (iii) THE CONTROL CASE. The linear model DID survive in monocytes — but only because someone ran the label-chase. That contrast is the point: the myeloid field did not accept the linear model on transfer + marker + kinetics alone. (C) ILC FIELD — THE MARKER/CYTOKINE AXIS IS PLASTIC AND BIDIRECTIONAL, AND THE SAME CYTOKINES ROMAGNANI USED ARE THE ONES THAT SWITCH ILC IDENTITY. (i) Ohne Y, Silver JS, Thompson-Snipes L, et al. "IL-1 is a critical regulator of group 2 innate lymphoid cell function and plasticity." Nat Immunol 2016;17:646-55. PMID 27111142 (record located; Methods NOT read). ILC2 acquire an ILC1-like phenotype under IL-1beta/IL-12 — surface- and cytokine-defined "subsets" interconvert under cytokine exposure with no lineage change. Romagnani 2007's entire in vitro arm is IL-2/IL-15/IL-12 driven, i.e. the identity-switching cytokine cocktail of the neighbouring field. (ii) Lim AI, Li Y, Lopez-Lastra S, ..., Di Santo JP. "Systemic Human ILC Precursors Provide a Substrate for Tissue ILC Differentiation." Cell 2017;168:1086-1100. PMID 28283063 (record read; Methods not in PMC). The methodological BAR the ILC field demanded of a human-blood-precursor claim: single-cell clonal in vitro assays, epigenetic poising of the signature loci, AND in vivo humanized-mouse reconstitution — and it still drew two immediate critical commentaries (Nat Rev Immunol 2017;17:216, PMID 28317924; Immunity 2017;46:344, PMID 28329700). Chan 2007 supplies a bulk sorted transfer with a two-marker flow readout and no clonal assay. By the standards of the field this claim's mechanism is borrowed from, it would not clear the bar. (iii) NK CELLS THEMSELVES SIT ON THE PLASTIC SIDE OF THIS BOUNDARY, DRIVEN BY THE SAME CYTOKINE AS THE REVERSE-DIRECTION NK RESULT. Cortez VS et al. "SMAD4 impedes the conversion of NK cells into ILC1-like cells by curtailing non-canonical TGF-beta signaling." Nat Immunol 2017;18:995-1003, PMID 28759002 (mouse, genetic). Human: "Interleukin-35 impairs human NK cell effector functions and induces their ILC1-like conversion with tissue residency features." Nat Commun 2025, PMID 40610398. THE CONVERGENCE THAT THE NK LITERATURE HAS NOT ABSORBED: TGF-beta is simultaneously (a) the signal that in Keskin 2007 drives human CD16+ NK "backward" to CD16-CD56bright-like decidual-type cells, and (b) the signal that in Cortez 2017 drives NK out of the NK compartment into ILC1. What the ILC field files as environment-driven plasticity, the NK field is reading as a fixed developmental step. If the NK/ILC1 boundary itself is TGF-beta- and IL-35-modulable, an intra-NK boundary marked only by NCAM1 surface density is a very poor candidate for an obligate lineage step. NET CROSS-FIELD VERDICT: the T cell field falsified the direction of this exact inference; the myeloid field falsified the transfer-into-empty-host assay and then supplied the human pulse-chase design that would settle it; the ILC field showed the cytokines used in the supporting in vitro arms are identity-switching agents, and set a clonal-assay bar this claim does not meet. All three collisions are invisible to NK keywords.

claim_text: Human NK development through stages 1-5 in secondary lymphoid tissue (Freud/Caligiuri)
primary_source_pmid: 16606675 (PMC2118285, doi 10.1084/jem.20052507) — PRIMARY for stages 1-4; 15780987 (doi 10.1016/j.immuni.2005.01.013) — antecedent for the stage-1 LN progenitor; NO primary source exists for "stage 5" (see notes)
species: human (JEM 2006: human tonsil and lymph node only; no animal work in the primary source). The strongest COUNTER-evidence is rhesus macaque (Wu 2018).
what_was_measured: In human secondary lymphoid tissue (tonsil and lymph node), CD3/CD19-depleted mononuclear cells were surface-stained for CD34, CD45RA, CD117 and CD94 and FACS-sorted to >99% purity into four cross-sectionally defined gates at a SINGLE ex vivo timepoint (no timecourse, no label, no tracer). Each sorted gate was then assayed for: ~15 surface markers by flow cytometry; CD34/CD122/ETS-1/GATA-3/T-BET transcript copy number by TaqMan qPCR normalised to 18S from >=2x10^4 sorted cells; 8-h luciferase-based lysis of K562 and Jurkat targets at E:T 20:1; 12-h IFN-gamma/GM-CSF/TNF-alpha/IL-13 ELISA after IL-12+IL-15+IL-18 or PMA+ionomycin+IL-2. Every stage-to-stage "transition" was then measured as the appearance of the downstream surface phenotype in CULTURE: 4 d to 5 wk in 200 uL wells in IL-15 (1 nM) with or without FL/IL-3/IL-7, on MS-5 stroma, on OP9-DL1 stroma, or with 10^4 sorted stage 3 or 4 cells plus 2.5x10^3 autologous anti-CD3/CD28-bead-activated tonsil T cells. Readout in every case = flow-cytometric re-phenotyping of the bulk well for CD34/CD117/CD94/CD56. Nothing was measured inside a human tissue over time; no cell was observed to convert.
n: Whole study: >50 tonsil donors and 30 lymph node donors (pooled tissue per donor). Individual experiments are much smaller: MS-5 bulk expansion n=4 (P=0.004); methylcellulose CFU "three separate experiments"; limiting-dilution NKP frequency 10 replicate wells per dose across 6 doses; qPCR from >=2x10^4 sorted cells per population. Number of donors contributing to the critical stage 3 -> stage 4 activated-T-cell co-culture is NOT stated in the paper.
n_unit: donors (human tonsil / lymph node tissue donors). NOT cells, NOT wells.
controls: Present and non-trivial, but none of them controls the key inference. (1) Sort purity >99%. (2) qPCR methodological control: CD34 mRNA highest in PB CD34+ HPC, undetectable in stages 3-4 and PB CD56bright. (3) Reference populations: total PB CD34+ HPC and PB CD56bright NK. (4) Lineage-potential POSITIVE controls: PB CD34+ HPC for erythro-myeloid CFU; cord-blood CD34+CD19- HPC for MS-5 B-cell cultures. (5) Reverse-direction controls (the strongest ones): stage 2 cultures did not yield CD34+CD117- stage 1 cells, and stage 4 cultures did not yield stage 3 cells — an explicit attempt to exclude backward conversion. (6) Cytotoxicity mechanism controls: EGTA/MgCl2, anti-TRAIL, anti-FasL, isotype-matched mAb. (7) Statistics: paired t test on log-transformed data. WHAT IS MISSING: no CFSE/dye-dilution, no barcoding, no single-cell or clonal assay, no spike-in contamination control. The claim that stage-1-derived CD34+CD117+ cells were made de novo rather than being day-0 stage-2 contaminants rests on an MFI ARGUMENT ("cultured stage 2 cells displayed lowered CD34 expression than the CD34(+)CD117(+) cells that had been derived from stage 1"), not on a control. Crellin 2010 ran exactly the CFSE and clonal controls that are absent here, and got the opposite answer.
strongest_alternative_explanation: SELECTION/OUTGROWTH OF A PRE-EXISTING MINOR SUBSET INSIDE AN UNDER-RESOLVED SORT GATE, PLUS CULTURE-IMPOSED PHENOTYPE CONVERSION. The stage gates are defined by only CD34/CD117/CD94, which cannot separate CD127+ RORC+ ILC3/LTi cells from CD127- committed NK precursors — both are Lin-CD34-CD117+CD94- and therefore both fall in "stage 3". Under this alternative, stage 3 is not a precursor state at all but a MIXTURE: a stable, self-renewing ILC3 lineage (the majority, which never becomes NK) plus a small CD127- NK-committed minority that simply expands in IL-15/DC/activated-T-cell culture. The bulk-well flow readout used throughout JEM 2006 cannot distinguish "stage 3 became stage 4" from "the 2% CD127- NK precursors in the stage 3 gate outgrew everything else". Freud's own data are consistent with selection rather than conversion: only "a small fraction (<=2%) of the sorted stage 3 cells were induced to express CD94" in IL-15, and stage 4 appeared only when extra non-physiological signals (OP9-DL1 Notch ligand, or anti-CD3/CD28-activated autologous T cells) were supplied. A second, compatible alternative is cytokine-driven ILC plasticity: IL-15/IL-12 can push RORgt+ ILC3 toward an NK-like/ILC1-like phenotype in vitro, so an in-culture phenotype switch is not evidence of a physiological developmental route. A third, independent alternative applies to the "in secondary lymphoid tissue" half of the claim: the intermediates may simply TRAFFIC through tonsil/LN rather than develop there — a possibility the authors themselves raise verbatim ("It is also unclear to what extent stage 4 cells, or any of the other NK cell lineage populations, actually arise within SLT or merely traffic through these tissues").

crossfield_g4_findings: The borrowed process is "a discrete differentiation ladder inferred from surface-marker sort gates plus in vitro/transfer output." That grammar has been tested to destruction in three neighbouring fields, and D4 has not survived any of those tests. **HEMATOPOIETIC-PROGENITOR / MYELOID HOME FIELD — the fatal collision.** Karamitros D et al., "Single-cell analysis reveals the continuum of human lympho-myeloid progenitor cells," Nat Immunol 2018;19:85-97, PMID 29167569 / PMC5884424: the human LMPP, GMP and MLP gates — built by exactly Freud's method (FACS gate + in vitro lineage output) — "were functionally and transcriptionally distinct and HETEROGENEOUS AT THE CLONAL LEVEL, with progenitors of many different functional potentials present. Although MOST progenitors had the potential to develop into only one mature cell type ('uni-lineage potential')..." and the authors conclude for "a continuum of progenitors ... rather than only uni-lineage progenitors' being present downstream of stem cells." This is the canonical, empirically proven instance of the exact alternative that applies to Freud's stage gates: bulk output from a marker gate is the SUM OF A MIXTURE, and the gate's apparent multipotency/progression evaporates at clonal resolution. Notta F et al., Science 2016;351:aab2116, PMID 26541609, "Distinct routes of lineage development reshape the human blood hierarchy across ontogeny," dissolved the discrete CMP stage the same way. Ginhoux F et al., Science 2010;330:841-845, PMID 20966214: in vivo fate mapping showed microglia/tissue macrophages are NOT the terminal rung of a monocyte ladder but a separate yolk-sac origin — a marker-and-culture-inferred ladder was wrong about ORIGIN, not merely about order. Schlitzer A et al., Nat Immunol 2015;16:718-728, PMID 26054720: cDC1 and cDC2 commitment already exists INSIDE the "common DC progenitor" gate — a gate that read as one upstream stage was pre-committed heterogeneity. Bearing on D4: every one of these says that Freud's stage 3 gate (Lin-CD34-CD117+CD94-, three markers) is expected a priori to be a mixture, and that bulk output from it cannot be read as conversion. **T CELL FIELD.** Buchholz VR et al., "Disparate individual fates compose robust CD8+ T cell immunity," Science 2013;340:630-635, PMID 23493420, and Gerlach C et al., "Heterogeneous differentiation patterns of individual CD8+ T cells," Science 2013;340:635-639, PMID 23493421: in vivo single-cell fate mapping showed that a smooth population-level "linear differentiation" curve is an ARTEFACT OF AVERAGING over individual cells with non-overlapping fates — the population trajectory belongs to no single cell. Bearing on D4: both of Freud's readouts (bulk-well flow re-phenotyping in JEM 2006; bulk 5e3-1e5-cell xenotransfer in Cell Rep 2016) are population averages of exactly the kind the T cell field demonstrated can be generated without any individual cell traversing the ladder. **ILC FIELD — the mechanistic collision.** Vonarbourg C, Mortha A, ... Diefenbach A, "Regulated expression of nuclear receptor RORgammat confers distinct functional fates to NK cell receptor-expressing RORgammat(+) innate lymphocytes," Immunity 2010;33:736-751, PMID 21093318 / PMC3042726: "By using ADOPTIVE TRANSFER OF GENETICALLY TAGGED LTi-like cells, we demonstrate that NKR-RORgammat(+) innate lymphocytes BUT NOT NK CELLS were direct progenitors to NKR(+)RORgammat(+) cells in vivo. GENETIC LINEAGE TRACING revealed that the differentiation of LTi-like cells was characterized by the stable upregulation of NKRs and a progressive loss of RORgammat expression. Whereas IL-7 and intestinal microbiota stabilized RORgammat expression within such NKR-LTi cells, **IL-12 AND IL-15 ACCELERATED RORgammat LOSS**." This is the borrowed mechanism's home-field kill shot and it is invisible to NK keywords. IL-15 at 1 nM is in EVERY culture in Freud JEM 2006 and is injected into every NSG recipient in Freud 2016; IL-12+IL-15+IL-18 is the stimulation cocktail. The ILC field's genetic fate mapping says those are precisely the cytokines that extinguish RORgammat and drive NK-receptor acquisition in an RORgammat+ innate lymphocyte — so "stage 3 cells acquire CD94 in IL-15" is the EXPECTED output of a cytokine-driven plasticity rheostat, and its fate-mapped in vivo endpoint is an IFN-gamma-producing, colitogenic ILC1, NOT a conventional NK cell. It also adjudicates between Crellin 2010 (stage 3 is a stable non-converting lineage) and Freud (stage 3 converts): the fate-mapping answer is that it converts but the destination is wrong, which is worse for D4 than either.

claim_text: Conventional NK -> adaptive NKG2C+ NK, HCMV-driven
species: human (primary claim); rhesus macaque (Truitt/Dunbar 2019 barcoding, Wu 2018 KLRC2) and mouse (Adams 2019 Ly49H transfer) used only for the clonal/transfer arms and for counter-evidence
what_was_measured: In humans, cross-sectionally: the percentage of NKG2C+ cells among peripheral blood lymphocytes was measured by flow cytometry in healthy adult blood donors and stratified by HCMV, EBV and HSV IgG serology and by HLA-E/KIR genotype (Gumá 2004, Blood). In humans, longitudinally in vivo: the percentage of CD57+NKG2Chi cells within total NK cells, plus Ki-67, was measured by flow cytometry in solid-organ-transplant recipients sampled repeatedly during hospitalization around the day CMV viremia was first detected by qPCR (day 0 = start of antiviral therapy) (López-Vergès 2011, PNAS). In vitro: the percentage of CD94/NKG2C+ cells among NKp46+CD3- cells was measured at day 10-21 in PBMC cocultured with HCMV-infected versus uninfected fibroblasts, +/- IL-15, +/- CD94-blocking mAb, +/- HCMV deletion mutants, with CFSE dye dilution as the proliferation readout (Gumá 2006, Blood; Rölle 2014, JCI). Clonally: mtscATAC-seq/ASAP-seq was run on ex vivo FACS-sorted CD3-CD14-CD19-CD7+ NKG2C+ and NKG2C- NK cells, with somatic mtDNA variants called as endogenous barcodes and chi-square tested against permuted clonotype-cluster assignments, at one timepoint in 4 HCMV+ and 3 HCMV- donors and again 7, 11 and 19 months later in 3 HCMV+ donors (Rückert 2022, Nat Immunol). CRITICAL: in none of these was a NKG2C-negative conventional NK cell or clone identified at t1 and re-identified as an NKG2C+ adaptive cell at t2. Every readout is a subset frequency, a receptor density, or a clonal mark scored within the already-adaptive compartment.
n: Gumá 2004 (founding source): n NOT extractable — full text paywalled (403), abstract gives no donor count. López-Vergès 2011 (origin of the directional claim): 29 HCMV+ and 24 HCMV- healthy donors, plus 6 viremic and 5 non-viremic solid-organ-transplant recipients. Rückert 2022 (clonal): 4 HCMV+ and 3 HCMV- donors for mtDNA barcoding; 3 HCMV+ donors resampled at 7, 11 and 19 months. Liu 2016 (counter-evidence): 2,208 screened, 60 NKG2C-/- and 60 NKG2C+ enrolled, of which 44 HCMV+ NKG2C-/- and 47 HCMV+ NKG2C+. Della Chiesa 2014 (counter): 3 UCBT patients grafted from NKG2C-/- donors. Rölle 2014 (in vitro): 71 cocultures, 38 meeting the >=2-fold expansion criterion. Foley 2012 J Immunol (transplant): 70 donor-recipient pairs, 22 with detectable CMV. Schlums 2015: 196 healthy donors + 78 HCT patients. Truitt/Dunbar 2019 (barcoded macaques): 3 RhCMV-seronegative + 2 RhCMV-seropositive macaques, of which only 2 were both barcode-transplanted AND experimentally RhCMV-infected. Adams 2019 (mouse co-transfer): 3-5 mice per experiment, 2 independent experiments.
n_unit: donors (human, the unit for every human study); animals (rhesus macaques, mice); wells/cocultures (Rölle 2014's "71" is wells, NOT donors — the paper does not state a donor count for that figure); donor-recipient pairs (Foley 2012)
controls: Yes, controls were present throughout and are generally good — they are controls for the ASSOCIATION, not for the lineage arrow. Gumá 2004: HCMV-seronegative donors, with EBV and HSV serology as virus-specificity controls, and HLA-E/KIR genotype as confounder controls. Gumá 2006: uninfected fibroblast cocultures, autologous vs allogeneic fibroblasts, multiple virus strains, CD94-blocking mAb, and UL16/UL18/UL40/US2-11 deletion mutants. López-Vergès 2011: CMV- SOT recipients and CMV+ non-viremic SOT recipients as the two comparison arms. Rückert 2022: 3 HCMV- donors, 1:1 NKG2C+/NKG2C- sort-enrichment to correct for differing subset frequencies, downsampling to equal cell numbers (4,300 and 6,000 cells), permuted clonotype-cluster relationships as an explicit null, and non-activating VMAPQSLLL vs activating VMAPRTLFL peptide in the RMA-S/HLA-E stimulation. Liu 2016: 60 NKG2C-sufficient controls plus 14 NKG2C+ and 16 NKG2C-/- HCMV-seronegative donors (none of whom had expansions). No study anywhere included the control that the claim actually requires: a purified, NKG2C-depleted conventional NK population followed for acquisition of the adaptive phenotype.
evidence_types_all: INF_KINETIC; INF_MARKER; INF_INVITRO; INF_TRAJECTORY; OBS_GENETIC; OBS_TRANSFER
strongest_alternative_explanation: HCMV SELECTS and clonally expands a PRE-EXISTING NKG2C+ subset rather than converting conventional NKG2C- NK cells — and this alternative is supported by the claim's own best papers. (1) Rückert 2022 shows "naive" NKG2C+ NK cells are present in HCMV- donors at frequencies comparable to HCMV+ donors, distributed across CD56bright and CD56dim, and that NKG2C+ vs NKG2C- cells in HCMV- donors are transcriptionally and epigenetically near-identical apart from KLRC2 itself. The paper's own stated hypothesis is "the expansion of individual naive NKG2C+ cells with unique accessible chromatin regions" and "a selection bottleneck during recruitment, followed by clonal expansion" — i.e. the founder is already NKG2C+. (2) Rölle 2014 CFSE dye dilution: "almost the entire NKG2C+ NK cell subset proliferated"; no experiment anywhere sorts NKG2C- cells and shows NKG2C acquisition. (3) Adams 2019 co-transferred congenically marked Ly49Hlo vs Ly49Hhi NK cells into MCMV-infected Ly49H-deficient hosts and showed the memory pool is filled by avidity SELECTION of pre-existing high-avidity cells, with corroborating higher NKG2C MFI on expanded human HSCT populations. (4) Truitt/Dunbar 2019 barcoded macaques: oligoclonal CD56-CD16+ NK clones were already present before RhCMV infection, and after infection new clones appeared while pre-existing clones disappeared — clone turnover, not tracked state conversion; authors conclude "RhCMV is not the sole driver of clonal expansion and peripheral maintenance of mature NK cells." A SECOND independent alternative is two separate origins: Bozzano 2021 (JACI) differentiates circulating Lin-CD34+DNAM-1brightCXCR4+ precursors directly into CD94/NKG2C+KIR+CD57+ progeny, bypassing any mature conventional NK intermediate, and PMID 40779632 (Sci Adv 2025) describes a thymus-derived human progenitor that generates KIR+NKG2A- NK cells. A THIRD: "conventional" and "adaptive" are the two ends of the ordinary CD56dim maturation axis (NKG2A -> KIR -> CD57) that HCMV merely skews, so cross-sectional adjacency and pseudotime ordering reflect an expression continuum, not a conversion event. Note also that the only genetic test of the arrow FAILS it (see counter_evidence).
counter_evidence: [audit] FOUND, and it is strong. (1) Liu LL et al., Cell Rep 2016;15:1088-99, PMID 27117418 — the single most damaging paper. Of 44 HCMV+ donors carrying homozygous KLRC2/NKG2C deletion, 11 (25%) had bona fide adaptive NK expansions (low CD7/CD161/FcepsilonR1gamma, high CD57/LILRB1, self-KIR repertoire skewing, demethylated IFNG CNS1) versus 16/47 (34%) of NKG2C-sufficient HCMV+ controls, Fisher p=0.27 n.s. NKG2C — the receptor that NAMES this claim — is dispensable. This is OBS_GENETIC evidence pointing AGAINST the claim as stated. (2) Della Chiesa M et al., J Immunol 2014;192:1471-9, PMID 24442432 — 3 patients transplanted with NKG2C-/- umbilical cord blood still developed CD56dim NKG2A- KIR+ mature expansions on HCMV infection. (3) Goodier MR et al., Blood 2014;124:2213-22, PMID 25150297 — NKG2C deletion attenuates but does not abolish HCMV-driven differentiation. (4) Adams NM et al., Immunity 2019;50:1381-1390.e5, PMID 31103381 — avidity SELECTION of a pre-existing pool, in mouse by co-transfer and in human by NKG2C receptor density. (5) Rölle A et al., JCI 2014;124:5305-16, PMID 25384219 — CFSE shows the in vitro effect is proliferation of already-NKG2C+ cells. (6) Truitt L et al. (Dunbar lab), Front Immunol 2019;10:2381, PMID 31649681 — lentivirally barcoded autologous HSPC transplant in RhCMV-seronegative rhesus macaques; oligoclonal NK clones pre-date CMV. (7) Bozzano F et al., J Allergy Clin Immunol 2021;147:2343-57, PMID 33493558 — alternative progenitor origin. (8) PMID 40779632, Sci Adv 2025 — a distinct thymic progenitor generating KIR+NKG2A- NK cells. (9) Rückert T et al., Nat Immunol 2022, PMID 36289449 — the flagship paper's own data on pre-existing "naive" NKG2C+ cells in HCMV- donors. || [adversarial] THREE the row missed, all located AND read. (1) STRONGEST NEW FIND — Bjorkstrom NK, Lindgren T, Stoltz M, ... Ljunggren H-G. J Exp Med 2011;208:13-21, PMID 21173105 / PMC3023129 (full text pulled, archived /home/user/aaa/refs/P1_PMC3023129.txt). The reviewer gave two answers conditional on scope: INF_KINETIC for the human NKG2C/HCMV claim, OBS_DIRECT for the mouse Ly49H/MCMV homolog (Flommersfeld 2021 single-cell colour-barcode fate mapping). The claim as written in spec section 1 is 'cNK -> adaptive NKG2C+ NK, HCMV-driven'.
