species: Human (primary evidence: first-trimester decidua and menstrual-blood-derived endometrial NK cells). Mouse (C57BL/6-Tg Act-EGFP aortic rings ex vivo; SCID-Beige females, 5-6 per group, JEG3 xenograft) used ONLY as bioassays for VEGFa activity in human dNK supernatants — no mouse experiment bears on persistence or ancestry.
what_was_measured: In humans, all HCMV-seropositive, a SINGLE cross-sectional measurement per woman was taken: (a) in first-trimester (6-14 wk gestation) decidua obtained at elective termination, flow cytometry measured %NKG2C-hi among CD56bright CD3- dNK and LILRB1 MFI on NKG2C-hi vs NKG2C-neg dNK, comparing primigravid to multigravid donors; (b) in menstrual blood collected on cycle days 1-2 from separate NON-PREGNANT women (nulligravid vs women who had given birth within the past 5 years), the same two flow readouts were measured on endometrial NK cells; (c) bulk RNA-seq compared sorted NKG2C-hi vs NKG2C-neg dNK as ONE library each, from 5 multigravid deciduas pooled before sorting; (d) bulk ATAC-seq compared NKG2C-hi dNK (primigravid vs multigravid) and NKG2C-hi eNK (nulligravid vs multigravid) as ONE library per group, from pooled donors (4 primigravid and 7 multigravid deciduas); (e) IFN-g and VEGFa were measured by ELISA/intracellular stain after 48-72 h co-culture of purified dNK with irradiated 721.221, 721.221-HLA-E or 721.221-HLA-G transfectants plus rhIL-15, with anti-CD94 and anti-LILRB1 blockade. No woman was sampled at more than one timepoint; no first-pregnancy and subsequent-pregnancy sample came from the same individual; no postpartum uterine tissue, decidua or endometrium was sampled at any point.
n: Flow-cytometry cohort sizes per figure live in Tables S1-S9, which I could not retrieve. Numbers stated in the main text / GEO: RNA-seq = 5 multigravid decidual donors POOLED into 1 sample, yielding 1 NKG2C-hi and 1 NKG2C-neg library (GSM2107769/70), no biological replicates, cuffdiff run on n=1 vs n=1; qRT-PCR validation on a second independent pool; LILRB1 MFI quantified on 8 multigravid decidua samples; decidual ATAC-seq = 4 primigravid donors pooled and 7 multigravid donors pooled, 1 library per group (GSM3030146/47), plus 1 pooled multigravid NKG2C-hi and 1 pooled NKG2C-neg library from 3 multigravid deciduas (GSM2689786/87); endometrial ATAC-seq = 1 pooled nulligravid and 1 pooled multigravid library (GSM3030144/45); Nuvaring subgroup = 3 nulligravid women; mouse xenograft = 5-6 mice/group; aortic rings = 6 rings/condition. GEO states explicitly for the decisive first-vs-subsequent-pregnancy ATAC comparison: "Tissue from sample GSM3030146 (positive_primigravidae_dNK) is from a different individual than sample GSM3030147 (positive_multigravidae_subsequent_pregnancy_dNK)."
n_unit: women (donors) for flow cytometry; for RNA-seq and ATAC-seq the effective statistical n is 1 SEQUENCING LIBRARY per group with multiple donors pooled before library prep, so donor-level variance is unestimable. Mouse assays are per animal (5-6/group) or per aortic ring (6/condition). No cell-level counts were used as n here.
controls: PRESENT: analysis restricted to HCMV-seropositive women (ImmunoComb II CMV IgG), explicitly to pre-empt the HCMV-adaptive-NK confound; matched isotype controls for every stain and sort; internal cell-type control (NKG2C on decidual T cells from the same women — no primigravid/multigravid difference); internal subset control (NKG2C-neg dNK from the same pooled sample as the NKG2C-hi RNA-seq/ATAC library); reported non-correlation of %NKG2C-hi with gestational week (Fig 1E) and with maternal age (Fig 1F); a gravidity>=2 / parity 0 subgroup (Fig 1G); parental 721.221 vs HLA-E and HLA-G transfectants, anti-CD94 and anti-LILRB1 blockade, and anti-VEGF (bevacizumab) blockade for the functional assays; exclusion of hormonal contraceptive users from the main menstrual cohort with Nuvaring users analysed separately. ABSENT AND MATERIAL: no age matching — primigravid donors averaged 22 y (18-27) and multigravid 34 y (24-45), a ~12 y gap in the exact axis along which HCMV-driven NKG2C-hi expansion accumulates; no CMV-seronegative comparison arm; no biological replicates for RNA-seq or ATAC-seq (n=1 library per group, donors pooled, so donor identity, HLA/KIR genotype and batch are perfectly confounded with group); no same-woman longitudinal sampling; no postpartum sample; no clonality, KIR-repertoire-clonality, barcoding, somatic-variant or fate-mapping assay of any kind; Student's t test applied uniformly, including to bounded proportion data.
strongest_alternative_explanation: Four alternatives, each individually sufficient, none excluded by the design. (1) AGE / CUMULATIVE HCMV EXPOSURE CONFOUND: the multigravid group is ~12 years older than the primigravid group (mean 34 vs 22). NKG2C-hi expansion is the canonical HCMV imprint and keeps accumulating with age and with duration of HCMV carriage even among seropositives, so restricting to HCMV-seropositive women controls serostatus but not exposure duration or reactivation history. The entire Figure 1 effect (2.93% vs 17.0%) is reproducible by age alone with zero pregnancy memory. (2) THE PAPER'S OWN NUVARING DATA REFUTE PREGNANCY-SPECIFICITY: 3 NEVER-PREGNANT women using an estradiol vaginal ring had endometrial NKG2C-hi frequencies "far greater than the nulligravid samples". A hormonal exposure with zero pregnancies reproduces the marker, so NKG2C-hi tracks steroid/uterine microenvironment conditioning, not a surviving pregnancy-experienced clone. (3) RECRUITMENT AND RE-DIFFERENTIATION INSTEAD OF PERSISTENCE: Strunz et al., Sci Immunol 2021 (PMID 33617461) show, using human uterus transplant recipients and monozygotic twins, that the uNK niche is replenished from the circulation and that uNK phenotype is under genetic control. A parous-vs-nulliparous phenotype difference therefore arises equally well from ongoing recruitment of blood NK into a differently conditioned uterus, with no cell surviving from the previous pregnancy. (4) POOLING ARTEFACT IN THE "EPIGENETIC SIGNATURE": with 1 ATAC library per group and donors pooled, every peak difference is confounded with donor identity and batch; and the authors themselves report that the IFNG and VEGFA enhancers — the mechanistic core of the memory model — "did not differ in genomic accessibility between the NKG2C-hi samples", i.e. the epigenetic mark that is supposed to be carried forward is precisely the one that fails to distinguish the populations. Additionally, the direction of the claimed arrow is wrong: the authors' own conclusion is that PTdNK PRECURSORS sit in the endometrium between pregnancies and are CONVERTED during the next pregnancy — and their attempt to perform that conversion in vitro on blood or endometrial NK failed ("Such conversion was unsuccessful").
counter_evidence: [audit] FOUND, and it targets exactly the load-bearing figure. Feyaerts D, van der Meer A, Joosten I, van der Molen RG. "Selective expansion and CMV-dependency in pregnancy trained human endometrial NK cells." Cell Mol Immunol 2019;16(4):410-411. PMID 30635647 / PMC6462002 (full text read). (ii) T CELL EXHAUSTION / EPIGENETIC FIXITY - two transferable lessons, plus a calibration for the sibling reversal claims R1-R3. The canon: Sen DR et al., Science 2016, PMID 27789799 (the exhaustion-specific enhancer landscape); Pauken KE et al., Science 2016, PMID 27789795 (that landscape is largely NOT remodeled by PD-1 blockade, so reinvigoration is transient); Khan O et al., Nature 2019, PMID 31207603, Scott AC et al., Nature 2019, PMID 31207604, Alfei F et al., Nature 2019, PMID 31207605 (TOX programs and reinforces it); Abdel-Hakeem MS et al., Nat Immunol 2021, PMID 34312545 ("epigenetic scarring" persists after antigen is removed); Beltra JC et al., Immunity 2020, PMID 32396847 (four exhausted subsets with distinct epigenetic control). crossfield_g4_findings: I searched the TRM/T cell, ILC and myeloid literatures on the structural question S2 actually turns on - "does recovering the same marker-defined subsets at two timepoints in a tissue mean the cells were carried?" - not the NK literature. Four things those fields establish, all of which bear against S2 and none of which the auditor invoked. (A) THE MYELOID FIELD SETTLED THIS EXACT QUESTION AND THE ANSWER IS NO. van de Laar L, Saelens W, De Prijck S, Martens L, Scott CL, et al. "Yolk Sac Macrophages, Fetal Liver, and Adult Monocytes Can Colonize an Empty Niche and Develop into Functional Tissue-Resident Macrophages." Immunity 2016;44:755-768, PMID 26992565. Traceable yolk-sac macrophages, fetal-liver monocytes and adult bone-marrow monocytes were transferred separately into the empty alveolar niche of neonatal Csf2rb-/- mice: "all precursors efficiently colonized the alveolar niche and generated AMs that were TRANSCRIPTIONALLY ALMOST IDENTICAL, self-maintained, and durably prevented alveolar proteinosis. Thus, PRECURSOR ORIGIN DOES NOT AFFECT the development of functional self-maintaining tissue-resident macrophages." This is a competitive, fate-mapped, in vivo demonstration that a tissue niche imposes a transcriptional identity on whatever enters it. Applied to S2: recovering three transcriptionally matched uNK states in decidua is exactly what the non-carriage model predicts, so the observation has essentially no discriminating power. The complementary result - Ginhoux F et al., Science 2010;330:841-5, PMID 20966214, and Hashimoto D et al., Immunity 2013;38:792-804, PMID 23601688 - is that cells sharing an identical marker phenotype in one tissue can have entirely distinct ontogenies, only resolvable by fate mapping. Marker identity is neither necessary nor sufficient for lineage continuity. (B) THE TRM FIELD SUPPLIES THE METHODOLOGY THE UTERINE FIELD HAS NOT APPLIED WITHIN A DONOR, AND SHOWS DE NOVO SUBSET REGENERATION. Snyder ME, Finlayson MO, Connors TJ, et al. "Generation and persistence of human tissue-resident memory T cells in lung transplantation." Sci Immunol 2019;4:eaav5581, PMID 30850393 - longitudinal airway sampling in HLA-DISPARATE lung transplant recipients, donor and recipient cells tracked by HLA: donor T cells persist in lung and express CD69/CD103/CD49a, while "lung-infiltrating RECIPIENT T cells GRADUALLY ACQUIRE TRM PHENOTYPES OVER MONTHS in vivo", and scRNA-seq showed recipient cells forming "similar TRM-like subpopulations, SUGGESTING DE NOVO TRM GENERATION". That is the precise structural counterexample: two cell pools of entirely different origin converge on the same marker-defined subsets in the same tissue. Bartolome-Casado R et al., J Exp Med 2019;216:2412-2426, PMID 31337737, shows the opposite outcome is also possible (donor CD8 TRM persist for years in transplanted human duodenum) - which is the point: persistence versus replacement is TISSUE-SPECIFIC and can only be settled by a chimerism or parabiosis experiment, never by phenotype. The uterus is the tissue where the chimerism experiment has been run (Strunz 2026 PMID 41811987; Asiimwe/Porrett 2026 PMID 41811989) and it came out on the replacement side. (C) THE T CELL FIELD HAS AN EXPLICIT FORMAL CRITIQUE OF MARKER-DEFINED SUBSETS STANDING IN FOR BEHAVIOURAL CLAIMS, AND IT ALSO INDICTS THE FREQUENCY COMPARISON. Steinert EM, Schenkel JM, et al. "Quantifying Memory CD8 T Cells Reveals Regionalization of Immunosurveillance." Cell 2015;161:737-749, PMID 25957682: "Paradigmatically, memory is parsed into central, effector, and resident subsets, OSTENSIBLY DEFINED BY IMMUNOSURVEILLANCE PATTERNS BUT IN PRACTICE IDENTIFIED BY PHENOTYPIC MARKERS ... we tested their validity via parabiosis and quantitative immunofluorescence microscopy" and found "lymphocyte isolation FAILS TO RECOVER MOST CELLS AND BIASES AGAINST CERTAIN SUBSETS". This is the same failure mode as S2 at two levels: a subset named for a fate but identified by CD39/CD103, and a cross-tissue frequency comparison built on isolation yields - which in Whettlock come from three DIFFERENT dissociation protocols (no enzyme for endometrium, gentleMACS for first trimester, 45 min Accutase at 37 C for third trimester). Steinert is the formal reason that comparison cannot be read as a subset-frequency time course. (D) THE ILC FIELD SHOWS TISSUE, NOT LINEAGE, DOMINATES THE TRANSCRIPTOME AND THAT SUBSET COUNT IS A RESOLUTION CHOICE. Mazzurana L, Czarnewski P, ... Mjosberg J. "Tissue-specific transcriptional imprinting and heterogeneity in human innate lymphoid cells revealed by full-length single-cell RNA-sequencing." Cell Res 2021;31:554-568, PMID 33420427 / PMC8089104 (full text archived, /home/user/aaa/refs/S2G4_PMC8089104.txt) - across multiple human tissues the tissue of residence imprints ILC transcriptomes more strongly than canonical subset identity, and Bjorklund AK et al., Nat Immunol 2016;17:451-460, PMID 26878113 showed human CD127+ ILC "subsets" resolve as graded heterogeneity by scRNA-seq. Both undercut the premise that "three subsets" is a transferable entity rather than a partition of a continuum - which is precisely the Guo 2024 (PMID 38566989, five effector + three proliferating clusters) and term-decidua-collapses-to-one-cluster problem the auditor identified from within the NK data. NET G4 VERDICT: every field that has run the decisive experiment (myeloid fate mapping, TRM parabiosis and transplant chimerism, ILC cross-tissue scRNA-seq) concludes that marker-defined or transcriptome-defined subset correspondence across two timepoints or two tissues carries no lineage information, and that niche instruction reliably regenerates the same states from unrelated precursors. S2's entire evidentiary basis is the kind of observation those fields specifically established to be uninformative.

strongest_alternative_explanation: SELECTION/EXPANSION OF A PRE-EXISTING SUBSET, plus local proliferation — and it is not a hypothetical. All three uNK subsets (uNK1/uNK2/uNK3) are already present in non-pregnant endometrium at menstrual, proliferative and secretory phase (Whettlock 2022), so every reported "pregnancy-induced adaptation" is fully explained by differential expansion/attrition of pre-existing states under progesterone and IL-15 with no cell changing identity: the frequency of a state can rise without any cell converting into it. The mouse experiment that can actually distinguish these — Sojka 2018, Ncr1-iCre x Rosa-mT/mG reporter mice in parabiosis with experimentally induced deciduomata — comes down on the expansion side: "the accumulated uNK cells were proliferating trNK cells; migrating NK cells made no contribution." The 2026 mouse Tbx21-Cre fate map likewise concludes "subset redistribution", explicitly "rather than undergoing lineage diversion." Two further alternatives are live: (i) REPLACEMENT FROM CIRCULATION — Vacca 2011 (PMID 21248224) shows CD34+ precursors resident in decidua differentiate into NK cells on stromal contact, i.e. de novo local generation from precursors rather than from eNK, and Carlino 2008 (PMID 18187664) shows chemokine-driven recruitment of circulating NK through decidual tissue; (ii) TECHNICAL ARTEFACT — the primary study's "endometrial" cells are menstrual-blood-derived and its "decidual" cells are enzymatically digested tissue, so the KIR-down/NCR-up difference could be a sampling and digestion-epitope artefact. Nothing in the human record discriminates conversion from any of these, because no human cell has ever been followed across the boundary.

crossfield_g4_findings: The structural questions S3 borrows are (i) recruitment versus residency and (ii) whether marker-ordered cross-sectional snapshots license an ancestry claim. All three home fields have solved these with methods the uterine NK field has never applied to this boundary, and every one of them cuts against S3. MYELOID — THE DECISIVE RESULT, AND IT KILLS THE INFERENCE OUTRIGHT. van de Laar L et al., "Yolk sac macrophages, fetal liver, and adult monocytes can colonize an empty niche and develop into functional tissue-resident macrophages", Immunity 2016;44(4):755-68, PMID 26992565: three ontogenetically unrelated precursor populations transferred into an empty alveolar niche each become phenotypically and functionally indistinguishable resident macrophages. Lavin Y et al., "Tissue-resident macrophage enhancer landscapes are shaped by the local microenvironment", Cell 2014;159(6):1312-26, PMID 25480296: the resident phenotype is written by the niche onto whatever cell occupies it, and transferred macrophages reprogram their enhancers to the host tissue. Also Machiels/organ-specific refilling dynamics, PMID 30540942. General principle: in a tissue niche, phenotype is determined by the niche, not by ancestry. S3 is an inference from phenotypic resemblance between a uterine population at time 1 and a uterine population at time 2 in DIFFERENT WOMEN. The myeloid field established that such resemblance is exactly what you get when unrelated cells occupy the same niche. This is not a caveat on S3's evidence; it is a demonstration that S3's evidence type cannot in principle discriminate the claim from its alternative. TRM / HUMAN TRANSPLANT CHIMERISM — THE FIELD'S ACTUAL STANDARD, AND IT SHOWS CONVERGENCE IN HUMANS. Snyder ME et al., "Generation and persistence of human tissue-resident memory T cells in lung transplantation", Sci Immunol 2019;4(33):eaav5581, PMID 30850393, PMC6435356 — methods read via lit.py: longitudinal airway sampling from HLA-disparate lung transplant recipients with donor and recipient cells tracked by HLA disparity. Verbatim: "Donor T cells persist specifically in the lungs (and not blood) of transplant recipients and express high levels of TRM signature markers including CD69, CD103, and CD49a, whereas lung-infiltrating recipient T cells gradually acquire TRM phenotypes over months in vivo", "suggesting de novo TRM generation." Bearing on S3: newly recruited blood-derived cells acquire the full tissue-residency marker signature (CD69, CD103, CD49a — the identical markers used to call a uterine cell "uNK") within months, in humans, in vivo. So a CD49a+CD69+ cell in first-trimester decidua is not evidence of descent from a CD49a+CD69+ cell in non-pregnant endometrium. This is the same HLA/SNP-disparity chimerism methodology as the auditor's Strunz 2026 STM, and it shows the inference S3 makes has been directly tested and invalidated in the one lineage where the experiment is routine. Mouse counterpart: Steinert EM et al., Cell 2015;161(4):737-49, PMID 25957682 — establishes that a residency claim requires intravascular labelling to exclude vascular contamination plus parabiosis to show non-equilibration. Neither has ever been performed for human eNK or dNK; Tatematsu 2025 (PMID 39708955) applies exactly this standard to the mouse uterus and finds the trNK are cNK-derived. ILC — RESIDENCY IS CONDITIONAL, AND PERTURBATION OPENS THE NICHE. Gasteiger G, Fan X, Dikiy S, Lee SY, Rudensky AY, "Tissue residency of innate lymphoid cells in lymphoid and nonlymphoid organs", Science 2015;350(6263):981-5, PMID 26472762, PMC4720139: ILCs are tissue-resident and locally self-renewing at steady state, "However, at later time points after infection, cells from hematogenous sources helped to partially replenish the pool of resident ILCs." The field that established ILC residency also established that residency does not survive a large perturbation. Pregnancy is the largest physiological perturbation the uterine niche undergoes, and Tatematsu 2025 shows the uterine ILC/NK niche is additionally under direct progesterone control. So the ILC field's own finding predicts hematogenous replenishment across precisely the boundary S3 assumes is closed. T CELL SUBSET-DIFFERENTIATION ORDERING — THE METHOD ITSELF IS FALSIFIED. Buchholz VR et al., "Disparate individual fates compose robust CD8+ T cell immunity", Science 2013;340(6132):630-5, PMID 23493420: single-cell fate mapping shows one naive precursor gives heterogeneous progeny, so a population-level ordering of subsets by marker acquisition systematically misassigns precursor-product relationships. This is the general refutation of the "sort the subsets, order them by marker acquisition, call it a differentiation pathway" method — which is exactly what Strunz 2021's title phrase "continuous human uterine NK cell differentiation" denotes (12 bulk RNA-seq libraries from 4 donors sorted into CD39-KIR-, CD39-KIR+, CD39+KIR+ per the auditor's own repository check) and what Whettlock 2022's uNK1/2/3 cross-stage ordering does. EXHAUSTION — searched for completeness though S3 does not invoke it: Blank CU et al., "Defining 'T cell exhaustion'", Nat Rev Immunol 2019;19(11):665-74, PMID 31570879 — the CD8 field's consensus that the label requires defined criteria (chronic antigen exposure, hierarchical inhibitory-receptor co-expression, a distinct epigenetic state) and must not be exported to other lineages on marker resemblance alone. Same structural lesson as above, not load-bearing for this claim. BOTTOM LINE FOR S3: every field that owns this mechanism converged on the same rule — you establish "A becomes B" in a tissue by chimerism (parabiosis in mouse, transplant/HSCT SNP or HLA disparity in human), never by comparing marker profiles of two populations sampled at two times. Applied to S3 that rule returns nothing supporting and four experiments opposing.

claim_text: cNK -> trNK (acquisition of a residency phenotype)
species: Human for the designated primary source (Cuff 2016: liver-transplant donor/recipient pairs, adult). Corroborating mouse primaries: C57BL/6 congenic CD45.1/CD45.2, Rag2-/-Il2rg-/- recipients, Ncr1-iCre x Eomes-fl/fl, Ncr1-iCre x Smad4-fl/fl, Ncr1-iCre x Tgfbr2-fl/fl, Tbx21-/-, Stat4-/-, Eomes-GFP. what_was_measured: In humans, in liver transplants mismatched at HLA-A2 or HLA-A3, at 3 h post-transplant (3 paired pre/post-transplant liver biopsies), 24-48 h post-transplant (blood, 7 mismatched transplants), and 8 days / 3 y / 6 y / 6 y / 13 y post-transplant (5 first-transplant livers explanted at re-transplantation), the readout was flow-cytometric frequency of Eomes-hi versus Eomes-lo NK cells — co-stained for T-bet, CXCR6, CD69, CD49a, CD103, CCR5, CX3CR1, S1PR1, perforin, granzyme B and granzyme K — within events gated as donor-origin or recipient-origin using HLA-A2-FITC / HLA-A3-FITC antibodies, in n = 5 explanted human livers. In the in vitro arm, sorted human blood Eomes-lo NK cells were cultured for 7 days in RPMI 1640 + 5 ng/ml IL-7, with or without IL-15 (20 ng/ml), IL-12 (50 ng/ml) or TGF-beta (5 ng/ml), and Eomes, T-bet and liver-retention molecules were measured by flow cytometry in n = 4 independent experiments. For the mouse arm most load-bearing on the claim (Park 2019): in mice, at 35 days post-infection with T. gondii, in 1:1 mixed bone-marrow chimeras (lethally irradiated recipients reconstituted with CD45.1 WT marrow plus CD45.2 Ncr1-iCre Eomes-fl/fl or Eomes-fl/fl marrow, used 6-8 weeks post-reconstitution), the readout was the CD45.1/CD45.2 origin of liver and spleen CD3-CD19-NK1.1+NKp46+ CD49a+Ly6C+ cells by flow cytometry. For the anchor counter-source (Sojka 2014): in mice, at 2 weeks after parabiosis surgery joining C57BL/6NCr (Ly5.2) to B6-LY5.1/Cr females, the readout was the CD45.1 versus CD45.2 allotype distribution of NK1.1+CD49a+DX5- versus NK1.1+CD49a-DX5+ cells in liver, uterus, skin and spleen by flow cytometry.

controls: Cuff 2016: (i) paired pre-transplant / 3 h post-transplant biopsies as the zero-timepoint control, establishing that "no recipient-derived Eomes-hi NK cells are present" at 3 h, so the later recipient-derived Eomes-hi cells are genuinely newly arrived; (ii) HLA-A2/A3 antibody gating with the reciprocal-genotype population in the same sample as an internal specificity control; (iii) donor-derived Eomes-hi NK cells persisting in the same liver as an internal comparator population; (iv) in vitro, IL-7-alone and single-cytokine wells as the cytokine controls, with CXCR6 tracked to exclude sort contamination. CRITICAL MISSING CONTROL: nothing excludes that the recipient-origin Eomes-hi cells derived from a recipient NK/ILC PRECURSOR or an intrahepatically differentiating progenitor rather than from a mature circulating cNK — the recipient contributes its entire haematopoietic system, not a sorted cNK input, so the input cell identity is uncontrolled. There is also no clonal marker, no timestamp on individual cells, and no control for local proliferation of the arriving cells. Park 2019 controls are stronger (WT:Eomes-fl/fl chimeras as the Cre-negative comparator, uninfected chimeras as the baseline, Eomes-independent CD49a+ ILC1s as the internal negative population). Sojka 2014 controls: spleen as the positive control for near-complete parabiotic chimerism, and CD49a-DX5+ cNK in the same tissue as the internal circulating-cell control.
strongest_alternative_explanation: A pre-existing, developmentally distinct trNK/ILC1 population is SELECTED and EXPANDED IN SITU rather than converted from cNK, and the marker overlap is read backwards as conversion. Three converging lines make this the leading alternative. (1) Direct positive demonstration of the alternative: Sojka et al. J Immunol 2018 (PMID 30275046) used an NK-specific reporter mouse plus parabiosis with experimentally induced deciduomata and found that the uterine NK accumulation during decidualization is LOCAL PROLIFERATION of pre-existing CD49a+ trNK — "migrating NK cells made no contribution." That is the canonical selection/expansion alternative shown to be true in the tissue where conversion was most confidently asserted. (2) Origin: genetic fate mapping shows hepatic ILC1/trNK are laid down by embryonic and neonatal waves and maintained locally (Sparano et al., Sci Immunol 2022, PMID 36054340, doi:10.1126/sciimmunol.abo6641), and liver IL-7R- ILC1s arise from fetal-liver group-1 ILCs fostered by hepatocyte-IL-15 parenchymal niches, with IL-7R+ ILC1s dispensable (eLife 2023, PMID 37352115) — a separate ontogenetic source that needs no cNK input. (3) Assay artefact in the supporting arm: Park et al. eLife 2019 states in plain text that "NK cells upregulated CD49a upon transfer into Rag2-/-Il2rg-/- mice, as previously reported" — i.e. the very residency marker used as the conversion readout is INDUCED BY THE LYMPHOPENIC TRANSFER ITSELF, which is the recipient background used for the adoptive-transfer evidence in this field. Two further alternatives: for the human transplant data specifically, recruitment of recipient-derived PRECURSORS (the authors' own wording: "some precursor of the Eomes-hi NK cells could be recruited to the liver from the circulation") rather than mature cNK; and, for the tumour/infection settings, differential attrition — cNK are killed or fail to expand while resident CD49a+ cells persist, producing an apparent phenotype shift in cross-sectional flow with no cell ever changing identity.
counter_evidence: [audit] FOUND, and it is stronger and more varied than the parabiosis result Claude cited. (1) Sojka 2014 eLife (PMID 24714492) — parabiosis, 2 weeks, C57BL/6NCr(Ly5.2)+B6-LY5.1/Cr females: host CD49a+DX5- trNK in liver, uterus and skin remain host-origin while CD49a-DX5+ cNK equilibrate; spleen reaches near-complete chimerism as the positive control. (2) Sojka 2018 J Immunol Cutting Edge (PMID 30275046) — NK-reporter mouse + parabiosis + deciduoma: uNK accumulation is proliferation of resident trNK; "migrating NK cells made no contribution." (3) Sparano et al. Sci Immunol 2022 (PMID 36054340) — genetic fate mapping: embryonic and neonatal waves generate hepatic ILC1s that layer and persist to adulthood; a developmental origin independent of adult cNK. (4) eLife 2023 (PMID 37352115) — fate mapping plus targeting of the IL-15-producing niche: liver 7R- ILC1s develop from fetal-liver G1-ILCs within sinusoids on hepatocyte-derived IL-15. (5) Park 2019 eLife (PMID 31393266) — even where conversion is supported, the T. gondii-induced CD49a+Ly6C+ "ex-NK" cells CIRCULATE (recovered in blood, and transferred cells disseminate to spleen), i.e. they gained CD49a WITHOUT gaining residency; the paper also flags the Rag2-/-Il2rg-/- CD49a artefact quoted above, and reports that congenic NK transfer could not be tracked past 14 d.p.i. and that Eomes-Cre fate mapping "was not possible." (6) Front Immunol 2022 (PMID 36605190, PMC9808525) — high-diversity barcoding of autologous HSPCs in 5 rhesus macaques with matched blood, lung, liver, spleen, jejunum, colon: the large expanded peripheral-blood CD56-CD16+ NK clones were "absent in CD56+16- TR NK across all tissues analyzed," and tissue NK carried tissue-specific clone sets — the only clonal (OBS_DIRECT-class) data in any species, and it argues against the mature circulating cNK pool being the source of the resident pool. (7) Ducimetiere et al. PNAS 2021 (PMID 34183415) — cNK (CD49a-CD49b+) and trILC1 (CD49a+CD49b-) act as two distinct populations with non-redundant roles in liver metastasis. (8) Cortez 2016 Immunity (PMID 27156386) — the authors who first showed WT splenic NK acquire CD49a/CD103/TRAIL/CD73 in vitro concluded that salivary-gland ILCs nevertheless develop IN SITU from a progenitor migrating early into the developing gland, not from converted splenic NK. (9) INTEGRITY: Gao 2017, the flagship conversion paper, carries a 2024 Author Correction (PMID 38514890) — a QIMR Berghofer investigation found Figs 5e and 6d,e and Supplementary Figs 5c,d and 8c "were based on experiments for which no evidence of their conduct or primary data could be confirmed... believed to have been fabricated or are unreliable." Journal and institution state the headline TGF-beta-driven conversion conclusion is unaffected, but part of the primary evidence for it is now withdrawn. || [adversarial] THE AUDITOR'S SINGLE BIGGEST MISS, and it falsifies an explicit claim in their row. They wrote: "NOT PRESENT ANYWHERE: OBS_DIRECT — no live imaging, no barcoding, no genetic fate mapping of a cNK becoming a trNK, in any species." That is FALSE. FLOMMERSFELD S et al., "Fate mapping of single NK cells identifies a type 1 innate lymphoid-like lineage that bridges innate and adaptive recognition of viral infection," Immunity 2021;54:2288 — PMID 34437840, PMC8528403, doi:10.1016/j.immuni.2021.08.002. Full text was already on disk at /home/user/aaa/refs/D2_PMC8528403.txt (archived under another claim's tag; the auditor never looked). Methods, verbatim: HSCs were transduced with retroviral constructs encoding fluorescent proteins and transplanted into irradiated C57BL/6 hosts (two times 4.5 Gy); "single color-barcoded CD27+Ly49H+ NK cells were sorted via flow cytometry from the spleens of these retrogenic donors and adoptively transferred to Rag2-/-Il2rg-/- recipients in a multiplexed fashion," with clones read out at day 8 p.i. after MCMV. This is single-cell clonal barcoding — the spec's own OBS_DIRECT definition — and it runs AGAINST the claim on three counts: (a) It resolves two SEPARATE lineages, one cNK-equivalent and one ILC1-like, rather than one converting into the other. Verbatim: "These data provide further evidence that ILC1-like NK cells do not serve as an immature progenitor of cNK cells but instead constitute a separate lineage." (b) It is a failure-to-interconvert result IN THE SAME lymphopenic Rag2-/-Il2rg-/- system used by the conversion papers: "the two subsets retained their distinct response behaviors" and "even without MCMV infection, no evidence for maturation of ILC1-like NK cells into the CD62L+ subsets was found." So when a defined single cell is actually tracked in that host, lineage identity is stable — which isolates the CD49a upregulation Park reports as a marker artefact rather than a fate change. (c) It independently corroborates the macaque HSPC barcoding the auditor did cite, and says so, noting that macaque CD56+ NK barcodes "did not fully overlap" with CD56- blood NK, "suggesting that lymphoid tissue-resident lineages may be distinct from cNK cells also in humans and non-human primates." CAVEAT I APPLY PER G2: Flommersfeld also runs RNA velocity, and the paper leans on it. That arm is INF_TRAJECTORY and I do not count it. Only the colour barcoding carries OBS_DIRECT weight. SECOND MISS — the mechanism paper relocates the event to ontogeny. "Autocrine TGF-beta1 drives tissue-specific differentiation and function of resident NK cells," J Exp Med 2025, PMID 39692745, PMC11654236. Its own framing is that NK cells "can establish residency in selected tissues DURING ONTOGENY," with cell-intrinsic TGF-beta continuously required for MAINTENANCE of trNK. That is a developmental-establishment-plus-maintenance model, not adult conversion of a circulating cNK, and it comes from the pro-TGF-beta side of the field. THIRD MISS — the ILC home field is now tracking this transition directly: "Single-cell analysis of recruited ILC2 cell fate during transition from circulation to establishment of tissue residency," 2026, PMID 41847845, PMC13017160. ONE POINT WHERE I DEFEND SOJKA AGAINST THE AUDITOR. The auditor dismissed Sojka 2014 partly because its Methods report no n (I confirmed this — the Parabiosis section is five sentences of surgical technique, no group size, no timepoint). But I also confirmed by grep of /home/user/aaa/refs/T1_PMC3975579.txt that Sojka used NO intravascular labeling and NO perfusion. Per the T cell field (below), omitting i.v. labeling means digested-tissue preparations are contaminated with marginated INTRAVASCULAR cells — which are partner-derived in a parabiont and therefore INFLATE apparent chimerism. The bias runs against Sojka's own conclusion, so their residency finding is robust to it. The auditor treated this assay as uniformly weak; it is weak on n and on inferring cell-level fate, but robust on the specific direction of this artefact.
downstream_dependency: CONCRETE NAMED DEPENDENCY 1: TGF-beta-insensitive engineered NK cell therapeutics — dominant-negative TGF-beta receptor II (DNRII) NK/CAR-NK constructs and TGFBR2-knockout NK products are justified on the explicit premise that tumour TGF-beta CONVERTS infused conventional NK cells into non-cytotoxic CD49a+ ILC1-like cells that cannot control tumour growth. That premise is Gao et al. 2017 Nat Immunol (PMID 28759001) — the paper now carrying the 2024 fabrication/unreliability Author Correction (PMID 38514890). If the mechanism is instead selection/attrition of cNK plus expansion of a pre-existing resident ILC1 pool, TGF-beta blockade in these products is protecting against a conversion event that may not occur, and the correct target is cNK survival/recruitment. CONCRETE NAMED DEPENDENCY 2: the "intILC1" (CD49a+CD49b+Eomes+) intermediate-state nomenclature introduced in Gao 2017, which is now routinely used to annotate CD49a+ clusters in tumour and liver scRNA-seq atlases as an NK-to-ILC1 transition state — and which, per G2, is then reinforced by pseudotime/RNA-velocity trajectories that are INF_TRAJECTORY and cannot establish direction. CONCRETE NAMED DEPENDENCY 3: the interpretation of CD49a+ tumour-infiltrating NK cells as "exhausted/converted cNK" rather than a separate resident lineage, which drives whether NKG2A/TGF-beta checkpoint strategies are expected to restore them.

adversarial_revision: UPHELD. evidence_type_strongest = INF_MARKER is UPHELD, but the auditor's REASONING is wrong and their evidence_types_all inventory is materially overstated. Three corrections found by going to the methods myself. (1) FACTUAL ERROR — CORTEZ 2017 DID NO ADOPTIVE TRANSFER AT ALL. The auditor wrote "OBS_TRANSFER = Gao 2017, Cortez 2017, Park 2019 — ALL of them into lymphopenic Rag2-/-Il2rg-/- hosts," while simultaneously admitting they never read Cortez 2017's methods ("no PMC deposit"). Both halves are wrong. Cortez 2017 DOES have a PMC deposit (PMC5712491, NIHMS921990), which I retrieved. Its Methods describe only conditional knockouts — Smad4-fl/fl, Tgfbr2-fl/fl, Bmpr2-fl/fl crossed to Ncr1-iCre and Il7r-Cre, all from Jackson — and contain NO adoptive transfer, NO recipient strain, and NO fate mapping. The auditor credited an OBS_ class to an experiment that does not exist, which is exactly the G1/G7 failure this screen is designed to catch. (2) OBS_TRANSFER IS HOLLOW AS SUPPORT AND SHOULD BE STRUCK OR HEAVILY CAVEATED. Spec A.3 requires "transfer A, recover B in recipient." Park 2019's transfer (archived T1_PMC6703900.txt) transferred NK cells and ILC1-like cells sorted from Eomes-GFP mice at 35 d.p.i. into Rag2-/-Il2rg-/- and recovered them 24 days later; verbatim: "Eomes expression remained high in most transferred NK cells." That is transfer A, recover A — a NEGATIVE result for conversion. The only thing that changed was CD49a, which the same sentence attributes to the assay ("NK cells upregulated CD49a upon transfer into Rag2-/-Il2rg-/- mice, as previously reported"). So of the three papers the auditor put in OBS_TRANSFER: one did no transfer (Cortez 2017), one is negative/artefactual (Park 2019), and one is unreadable and carries a fabrication finding on the relevant figures (Gao 2017). I re-attempted Gao 2017 via nature.com/articles/ni.3800 and hit the same idp.nature.com paywall the auditor did — SEARCHED AND UNOBTAINABLE, confirming that one point. (3) OBS_GENETIC (Park 2019) IS REAL BUT CANNOT DISCRIMINATE THE ALTERNATIVE. I verified the WT:Ncr1-iCre-Eomes-fl/fl mixed BM chimera passage verbatim ("approximately three times as many CD49a+Ly6C+ cells were derived from Eomes-dependent cells, that is, NK cells"). It meets the letter of OBS_GENETIC. But Eomes-cKO marrow cannot generate mature NK cells at all, so the deficit is equally explained by absence of an NK-committed PRECURSOR pool as by failure of a mature circulating cNK to convert. It is a developmental-origin inference, not an observation of conversion. Park's authors say so themselves: Eomes-Cre fate mapping "was not possible due to the ubiquitous expression of Eomes during development," and congenic NK transfer failed "due to the inability to find transferred cells after 14 d.p.i." WHY INF_MARKER NONETHELESS STANDS, for a better reason than the auditor's: the claim as written is about acquiring RESIDENCY. The OBS_GENETIC and OBS_TRANSFER experiments in this corpus score CD49a/Ly6C, not residency — and Park's converted cells demonstrably circulate. So no OBS_ class in the corpus actually addresses the claim as stated; what remains is marker phenotype. The auditor reached the right label by the wrong route (anchoring on "first primary source") and then hedged by "recording both readings," which dodges A.3's requirement of exactly one strongest class.
crossfield_g4_findings: THE AUDITOR RAN ZERO CROSS-FIELD SEARCHES. Their 24-item searches_run list is entirely NK/ILC1. This is a straight G4 violation, and the home fields turn out to be decisive. A. THE TRM FIELD ALREADY RAN THIS EXACT DEBATE AND SETTLED IT — AGAINST THE SIMPLE CONVERSION MODEL. The answer is not "circulating cells convert" but "a PRE-COMMITTED subset within the circulating pool is selected and completes differentiation locally" — which is precisely the canonical alternative this screen asks about, established as true in the home field. - Mackay LK et al., Nat Immunol 2013, PMID 24162776: skin CD103+ TRM develop from epithelium-infiltrating precursors that LACK KLRG1, requiring local IL-15 and TGF-beta. The pre-existing subset is identifiable before it becomes resident. - Kok L et al., J Exp Med 2020, PMID 32728699 — title is the finding: "A committed tissue-resident memory T cell precursor within the circulating CD8+ effector T cell pool." - Sci Immunol 2024, PMID 38941479 (erratum PMID 39423287): even KLRG1+ long-lived effector memory cells "retain the flexibility to become tissue resident" — so the field's mature position is BOTH selection of a pre-committed subset AND residual plasticity, quantitatively separated. - Herndler-Brandstetter D et al., Immunity 2018, PMID 29625895: separating these required an INDUCIBLE GENETIC FATE MAP (ex-KLRG1 lineage tracing). METHODOLOGICAL VERDICT: the discriminating tool exists and has worked for a decade in an adjacent lineage. The NK field has not applied it to cNK→trNK; Park 2019 states in plain text that the equivalent experiment "was not possible." T1 therefore sits at the evidentiary stage TRM biology occupied around 2013. B. TGF-BETA-DRIVEN RESIDENCY MARKERS CARRY NO LINEAGE INFORMATION — established outside the NK field. Zhang N & Bevan MJ, Immunity 2013, PMID 24076049: TGF-beta signaling controls the FORMATION AND MAINTENANCE of gut-resident memory T cells, and TGF-beta induces CD103. So CD103/CD49a-class residency markers are TGF-beta-inducible STATE markers imposed by the niche on whatever lymphocyte occupies it. This simultaneously makes the T1 mechanism plausible and destroys the marker-based inference used to assert it — the exact INF_MARKER trap. Cortez 2016's in vitro result (splenic NK + TGF-beta1 + IL-2 -> CD49a/CD103) is the expected behaviour of any lymphocyte in a TGF-beta-high niche, not evidence of a lineage transition. C. TWO ASSAY ARTEFACTS THE NK PAPERS ARE EXPOSED TO, BOTH DISCOVERED IN THE T CELL FIELD. - Anderson KG et al., J Immunol 2012, PMID 22896631 ("intravascular staining redefines lung CD8 T cell responses") and Nat Protoc 2014, PMID 24385150: without i.v. anti-CD45 labeling, a large fraction of lymphocytes recovered from digested tissue are VASCULAR, not resident. I checked: Sojka 2014 used none. Neither, on the accessible text, do the tumour/infection studies that infer conversion from a shifting CD49a+/CD49a- ratio in digested tissue — in liver especially, where the marginated sinusoidal NK pool is large. A cross-sectional ratio shift in an unlabeled digest is not evidence any cell changed. - Steinert EM et al., Cell 2015, PMID 25957682: quantitative imaging versus flow showed flow cytometry of digested tissue substantially and NON-UNIFORMLY undercounts tissue lymphocytes. Differential recovery of CD49a+ versus CD49a- cells alone can manufacture an apparent "conversion" — which is the differential-attrition alternative, given an independent mechanistic basis. D. THE MYELOID FIELD IS THE CLOSEST STRUCTURAL PRECEDENT, AND IT RESOLVED THE OPPOSITE WAY. Hashimoto D et al., Immunity 2013, PMID 23601688: "Tissue-resident macrophages self-maintain locally throughout adult life with minimal contribution from circulating monocytes." The myeloid field spent a decade believing circulating cells replenish the resident pool; fate mapping plus parabiosis overturned it in favour of embryonically seeded, locally self-renewing populations. That is structurally identical to Sparano 2022 (PMID 36054340) on embryonic/neonatal hepatic ILC1 waves — which the auditor cited but did not recognise as an instance of a general, already-resolved pattern. The myeloid field also established that when circulating cells DO fill an emptied niche they adopt the resident signature — giving an independent, home-field-grounded explanation for Park's Rag2-/-Il2rg-/- CD49a artefact: an empty niche imposes the resident phenotype on whatever fills it, so every lymphopenic-transfer result in this corpus is confounded by design, not by accident. NET G4 VERDICT: three of the four cross-field lines (committed-precursor selection, TGF-beta as a niche-imposed state marker, embryonic seeding with local self-renewal) support the SELECTION/PRE-EXISTING-SUBSET alternative over conversion; the fourth (TRM plasticity) shows conversion can be real but is only demonstrable with inducible fate mapping the NK field has not performed.

what_was_measured: In mice, 2.5x10^6 negatively-selected CD45.2+ splenic cNK cells (gated CD3-CD19-NK1.1+NKp46+CD49b+; stated purity 87-93%) were injected i.v. via tail vein into pregnant C57BL/6-CD45.1 dams at gestational day 0.5; at gd10.5 individual implantation sites were Liberase TL/DNase-digested and the surface/intranuclear phenotype (CD49a, CD49b, Eomes, NK1.1, NKp46) of donor-derived CD45.1-negative CD45.2+ cells was read out by flow cytometry with Precision Count Beads, in n=4 pregnant dams; a subset of donor cells scored CD49a+CD49b-Eomes+. In parallel, at gd6.5/10.5/14.5 an i.v. anti-CD45.2-PE-Cy7 pulse 3 min before euthanasia was used to score which uterine NK populations were intravascular versus extravascular, and TGF-betaRII surface staining was compared between splenic and uterine cNK. Separately, absolute number and frequency of CD49a+Eomes+ trNK, CD49a+Eomes- ILC1 and CD49b+Eomes+ cNK in gd10.5 implantation sites were compared between TGF-betaRII-Ncr1-delta dams and littermate controls, and 3.0x10^6 purified CD45.1+ cNK (vs HBSS vehicle) were transferred into pregnant TGF-betaRII-Ncr1-delta dams at gd0.5 (n=3 reconstituted vs n=4 vehicle). Pregnancy readouts at gd10.5 were implantation-site count, resorption rate, and blinded stereological measurement of decidual spiral artery lumen area and wall thickness on Masson's-trichrome midsagittal sections (>=4 implantation sites per litter).

Group sizes for the TGF-betaRII-Ncr1-delta vs littermate-control comparisons are not stated in the Methods text and are reported only in figure panels; the paper states only that sample sizes were set for alpha=0.5 (sic, likely typo for 0.05) and 85% power. controls: (1) Congenic CD45.1/CD45.2 discrimination of donor from host cells; (2) dams mated to CD45.1 MALES so that fetal lymphocytes at the maternal-fetal interface are excluded from the maternal donor gate; (3) i.v. anti-CD45.2-PE-Cy7 3 min pre-euthanasia to exclude blood-borne cells from the tissue-resident gate; (4) Cre-negative/flox littermate controls for TGF-betaRII-Ncr1-delta (reviewers additionally prompted separate characterisation of Ncr1-iCre-only controls); (5) HBSS vehicle-only controls for the reconstitution arm; (6) splenic cNK numbers/frequencies compared between genotypes as an internal specificity control (unchanged); (7) blinding of investigators to genotype during spiral artery morphometry; (8) fixable viability dye and 2.4G2 Fc block. MISSING controls: no no-transfer/isotype-transfer baseline for the donor gate; no pre-transfer CD49a/Eomes staining of the actual inoculum reported (only CD49b+ purity 87-93%); no proliferation dye (CFSE/CTV) or Ki67 to separate conversion from selective expansion; no clonal/barcode or genetic fate-mapping label; no non-pregnant/virgin transfer arm in this paper.
strongest_alternative_explanation: Selection and expansion of a pre-existing convertible/committed minority within the inoculum, not conversion of a bona fide conventional NK cell. The transferred population was negatively selected to only 87-93% purity, i.e. up to 13% of 2.5x10^6 = up to ~325,000 injected cells were NOT the intended CD3-CD19-NK1.1+NKp46+CD49b+ cNK, and the paper reports no pre-transfer CD49a/Eomes profile of the inoculum. Only "very few" donor cells were recovered from the uterus (eLife Reviewer #2's phrasing), so a rare pre-existing CD49a+ trNK-like cell, an NK precursor, or a CD49b+ subset already licensed for residency, selectively retained and locally expanded in the uterine niche, would generate an identical CD49a+CD49b-Eomes+ donor readout with no conversion having occurred. Nothing in the design excludes this: there is no proliferation dye, no Ki67, no clonal barcode and no intermediate timepoint between gd0.5 and gd10.5, and Sojka et al. J Immunol 2018 (PMID 30275046) independently showed uterine trNK proliferate locally during decidualization, which is exactly the amplification step selection would exploit. Reviewer #2 raised this directly, asking whether "only a specific subset of (splenic) cNK [is] capable of differentiating into trNK". A second, separate alternative applies to the genetic arm: eLife Reviewer #1 noted that the accumulation of CD49b+ cNK in the TGF-betaRII-Ncr1-delta uterus "suggests a defect in tissue retention rather than recruitment" — since Ncr1-iCre deletes in ALL NKp46+ cells including established uterine trNK and ILC1, the reduced trNK number is equally consistent with failure to MAINTAIN a resident population as with a blocked cNK-to-trNK conversion. Finally, the entire endpoint is INF_MARKER-grade: "trNK" here is defined solely by CD49a+CD49b-Eomes+ plus exclusion from the i.v. label, with no function, no transcriptome, and (contrary to the task hint) no CD9 and no CD69 measured on the donor cells.
counter_evidence: [audit] Substantial and partly from the same lab. (1) Chiossone L et al., Haematologica 2014;99:448-457, PMID 24179150 — the direct contradiction: transfer experiments from EGFP+ mice into pregnant mice showed that peripheral MATURE NK cells "did not migrate into decidua and uterus", while only NK PRECURSORS were recruited and differentiated in situ; they identified proliferating immature NK precursors in decidua/uterus as early as gd4.5. This is the same experimental design as Barahona's with the opposite result. (2) Sojka DK et al., eLife 2014;3:e01659, PMID 24714492 — from Yokoyama's own lab, concluded uterine trNK are a SEPARATE LINEAGE from cNK: uterine trNK persist in NFIL3-deficient mice in which cNK are absent, and persist in T-bet-deficient mice, i.e. two genetic dissociations from the cNK lineage; their uterine parabiosis at 2 weeks also found host CD49a+DX5- trNK to be overwhelmingly host-derived despite near-complete splenic chimerism. The 2026 paper does not address the NFIL3 result. (3) Chantakru S et al., J Immunol 2002;168:22-28, PMID 11751942 — orthotopic uterine grafts plus transfers of thymus/BM/LN/spleen cells into NK-deficient recipients supported "precursor cell recruitment", not conversion of mature cNK. (4) Sojka DK et al., J Immunol 2018;201:2551-2556, PMID 30275046 — local proliferation of resident uterine trNK during decidualization, i.e. the expansion-of-pre-existing-cells alternative. (5) Vacca P et al., PNAS 2011;108:2402-2407, PMID 21248224 — human decidual CD34+ hematopoietic precursors differentiate into NK cells on stromal contact: a second, independent local origin. (6) The human corroboration the paper leans on (recipient-genotype uNK after uterus transplantation; bioRxiv 2024.03.04.583277, still a preprint) shows blood-borne replenishment but cannot distinguish a mature cNK converting from a circulating precursor seeding, so it does not resolve the same ambiguity. || [adversarial] Four items the prior auditor missed, two of them decisive. (1) Flommersfeld S et al., Immunity 2021;54:2288-2304, PMID 34437840 (full text archived /home/user/aaa/refs/T2_PMC8528403.txt) — THE NAMED PRE-EXISTING SUBSET. Retrogenic colour-barcode fate mapping of SINGLE NK cells plus congenic parabiosis identified "two distinct NK cell lineages present already during the steady state and stably maintained throughout infection." The second is a CD27+CD62L-CD160+ "ILC1-like NK" population that is Eomes+, NK1.1+, NKp46+, CD69+, "expressed CD49b (albeit less than CD62L+ subsets), and, like these, lacked CD49a," and by parabiosis "remained almost entirely spleen resident, while cNK cells equilibrated between the two parabionts." This is exactly the cell Barahona's CD3-CD19-NK1.1+NKp46+CD49b+ negative-selection inoculum co-purifies: Eomes+, CD49a-negative at the time of transfer, already carrying a residency programme, and a lineage that does NOT interconvert with cNK. Its CD49a-upregulating progeny would score identically in Barahona's donor gate with no cNK-to-trNK conversion having occurred. The auditor gestured at "a rare pre-existing CD49a+ trNK-like cell" but never named this population or this paper. (2) Torcellan T et al., Immunity 2024;57:124-140, PMID 38157853 (archived T2_PMC10783803.txt) — cited in Barahona's own reference list, and it indicts Barahona's assay by name: "The tracking and manipulation of NK cells... have been largely limited to adoptive transfer approaches... This approach bears the caveat of co-transferring progenitor populations and spleen-resident ILC-like NK cells, which may confound the cellular origin of the cells engrafting into tissues." They therefore replaced transfer with inducible genetic fate mapping (Sell-CreERT2 and Eomes-CreERT2 x Rosa26-LSL-tdTomato) plus percutaneous Dendra2 photoconversion, which simultaneously proved residency AND excluded proliferative dilution. Barahona did none of this. Torcellan also found salivary-gland trNK develop independently of cNK and of Eomes, i.e. two independent trNK origins within one animal. (3) Boulenouar S et al., Front Immunol 2016;7:43, PMID 26925058 (archived T2_PMC4759249.txt) — the PREGNANCY-SPECIFIC NFIL3 contradiction, far more damaging than the auditor's Sojka 2014. In Nfil3-/- dams (cNK development crippled), uterine CD49a+Eomes+ trNK expanded about sevenfold during pregnancy, "nearly as extensive as in pregnant WT mice," while uterine CD49a-DX5+ cNK "did not expand at all" (vs 3.7-fold in WT). Pregnancy-associated accumulation of uterine trNK therefore proceeds essentially normally when the putative circulating source is absent. The same paper also destroys the gating premise: "The expression of CD49a and DX5 has been described as mutually exclusive on the two subsets both in liver and uterus; however, we found that DX5 was expressed on most uterine CD49a+ cells" — so CD49a+CD49b- is not a clean partition in the uterus, and DX5/CD49b levels are themselves NFIL3- and context-regulated. (4) Filipovic I et al., Nat Commun 2018;9:4492, PMID 30374017 (archived T2_PMC6206068.txt) — a genuine genetic fate map of the uterus that Barahona ignores: Rorc(RORgt)-fate-map YFP+ cells are present among uterine group 1 ILCs, "aligned with 'ex-ILC3s' described in other tissues," i.e. a THIRD, ILC3-derived origin; and uterine trNK are Ki67-high at gd9.5, the local-proliferation route. Also, the eLife public reviews (obtained only via WebFetch summarisation, NOT verbatim — same limitation the prior auditor flagged) state that reviewers asked whether "only a specific subset of (splenic) cNK [is] capable of differentiating into trNK," raised "local proliferation of cNK-derived trNK," noted only "very few cells can be detected within the uterus," and asked that the "conversion" conclusion be "toned down"; the authors' revised text concedes cNK entering the uterine vasculature "may fail to acquire molecular programs required for residency and instead continue to transit." The auditor's Chiossone 2014 (PMID 24179150), Sojka 2014 (PMID 24714492), Chantakru 2002 (PMID 11751942), Sojka 2018 (PMID 30275046) and Vacca 2011 (PMID 21248224) all stand as cited.
downstream_dependency: Concrete named dependencies: (a) Registry claim T3 ("Peripheral blood NK -> decidual NK-like", currently graded IN VITRO ONLY on Keskin 2007 PMID 17360654 / Cerdeira 2013) — Barahona 2026 is the ONLY in vivo TGF-beta-driven evidence that would license upgrading T3 out of the in vitro-only class, and the paper explicitly invokes Keskin as the conserved human counterpart. If T2's transfer is really selection, T3 stays in vitro-only. (b) Registry claim T1 ("cNK -> trNK, acquisition of a residency phenotype", currently MIXED) — T2 is the per-tissue instance carrying the "adoptive transfer for" side of T1. (c) Within the primary source itself, the causal attribution of the TGF-betaRII-Ncr1-delta pregnancy phenotype (37% reduction in decidual spiral artery luminal area, 75% increase in wall thickness, increased gd10.5 resorption, reduced litter size at first parturition) specifically to failed cNK-to-trNK conversion — an attribution that is confounded because the same knockout also markedly depletes uterine ILC1s. (d) Registry claim R3 (TGF-beta withdrawal reverts residency) presupposes TGF-beta as the residency-imposing signal that T2 establishes in the uterus. Graded MEDIUM rather than HIGH because the claim is only ~1 year old (Dec 2024 parabiosis, 2026 transfer), rests on one lab-pair, and the older reproductive-immunology literature (Chantakru 2002, Chiossone 2014) still supports a competing precursor-recruitment model that remains widely cited.
adversarial_revision: ADVERSARIAL_DOWNGRADE: OBS_TRANSFER -> OBS_TRANSFER. OBS_TRANSFER — retained as strongest class, but downgraded in weight: congenic (CD45.1/CD45.2) adoptive transfer with donor recovery, endpoint defined ONLY by CD49a+CD49b-Eomes+ surface/intranuclear staining, with residency of donor cells never tested (no intravascular label applied to transfer recipients), no conversion frequency reported, n=4 dams, single 10-day interval. Revised evidence_types_
crossfield_g4_findings: The mechanism invoked is circulating-to-resident conversion under TGF-beta. Three home fields have already run this argument and each returns a lesson that Barahona's design fails. T CELL / TRM. (a) SELECTION WAS THE ANSWER LAST TIME. Mackay LK et al., Nat Immunol 2013;14:1294-1301, PMID 24162776, "The developmental pathway for CD103+CD8+ tissue-resident memory T cells of skin": skin TRM do not arise from bulk effectors — they arise from a PRE-EXISTING KLRG1-negative subset, with KLRG1+ effectors largely excluded. The field that invented the transfer-and-recover assay discovered, using that assay plus subset fractionation, that the apparent conversion was selection of a minority already licensed for residency. Barahona transferred an unfractionated 87-93%-pure bulk inoculum with no pre-transfer phenotype and no subset fractionation, so it sits on the wrong side of exactly this lesson. (b) TGF-beta IS A TRAFFICKING AND RETENTION SIGNAL, NOT ONLY A DIFFERENTIATION SIGNAL. Zhang N & Bevan MJ, Immunity 2013;39:687-696, PMID 24076049: TGF-beta controls formation AND maintenance of gut TRM "by regulating migration and retention." Ma C et al., J Immunol 2017;198:749-756, PMID 27903738: TGF-beta promotes kidney-resident T cell formation by enhancing E-/P-selectin- and chemokine-mediated EXTRAVASATION of effector T cells — it acts at the tissue-ENTRY checkpoint. A Tgfbr2 conditional knockout that reduces resident-phenotype cells is therefore the null expectation under trafficking/retention alone. Barahona's KO arm has no entry, retention or proliferation readout, and its most striking result — uterine CD49b+Eomes+ cNK ACCUMULATE while trNK fall — is the classic signature of cells arriving but not being retained. (c) RESIDENCY MUST BE MEASURED, NOT INFERRED FROM MARKERS. Skon CN et al., Nat Immunol 2013;14:1285-1293, PMID 24162775 (S1pr1 downregulation is required for residency) and Anderson KG et al., Nat Protoc 2014;9:209-222, PMID 24385150 (intravascular staining as the field standard) set the bar. Barahona applied the intravascular standard to endogenous cells only and NOT to the donor cells — the one place the claim needed it. (d) WHAT PARABIOSIS CANNOT PROVE — bears directly on the priority source. Parabiosis measures exchange of a labelled compartment. Blood carries NK and ILC precursors as well as mature cNK, so partner-derived cells acquiring a trNK phenotype in a parabiont are equally consistent with precursor seeding. Tatematsu & Sojka 2025 (PMID 39708955), the priority claimant, is a parabiosis + intravascular-label study and is therefore intrinsically unable to discriminate mature-cNK conversion from precursor recruitment — precisely the model that Chiossone 2014 (PMID 24179150) and Vacca 2011 (PMID 21248224) support for the uterus. ILC. (e) Flommersfeld 2021 (PMID 34437840) as above: two pre-existing, non-interconverting NK lineages in the steady-state spleen, one of them spleen-RESIDENT, Eomes+, CD69+, CD49b-positive-but-low, CD49a-negative — a named, characterised candidate for the "convertible minority" in Barahona's inoculum, established by single-cell barcoding, the strongest available lineage method. (f) Zeis P et al., Immunity 2020;53:775-792, PMID 33002412, "In Situ Maturation and Tissue Adaptation of Type 2 Innate Lymphoid Cell Progenitors": ILC progenitors seed tissues and mature IN SITU, acquiring tissue-specific phenotypes — the ILC-field version of precursor seeding, which reproduces a "circulating-cell-becomes-resident-phenotype" readout with no mature-cell conversion. (g) THE ENDPOINT MARKERS ARE GENERIC. Gao Y et al., Nat Immunol 2017;18:1004-1015, PMID 28759001 and Cortez VS et al., Nat Immunol 2017;18:995-1003, PMID 28759002 established that TGF-beta/SMAD signalling drives cNK toward a CD49a+ ILC1-like state in tumours, and Cortez 2016 (PMID 27156386) in salivary gland; Cuff 2019 (PMID 31572388) in obese liver. CD49a-up/CD49b-down/Eomes-retained is a generic TGF-beta response readable in at least four unrelated tissues, so it identifies a TGF-beta-exposed NK cell, not a uterine trNK. This is why the endpoint is INF_MARKER-grade. (h) Torcellan 2024: Tgfbr2 deletion blocks salivary-gland trNK but NOT skin trNK — tissue-specific, so the Tgfbr2 result cannot be generalised into a conversion mechanism. MYELOID — THE HARDEST LESSON. (i) Ginhoux F et al., Science 2010;330:841-845, PMID 20966214 and Hashimoto D et al., Immunity 2013;38:792-804, PMID 23601688: genetic fate mapping overturned decades of transfer- and chimerism-based dogma that blood monocytes generate tissue macrophages; most resident macrophages are embryonically seeded and self-renew locally. Transfer-plus-phenotype was the assay that got it wrong, and fate mapping was the assay that fixed it. (j) Guilliams M & Scott CL, Nat Rev Immunol 2017;17:451-460, PMID 28461703, "Does niche competition determine the origin of tissue-resident macrophages?" — the decisive methodological point. When a resident niche is empty or expanding, circulating cells fill it and adopt the FULL resident transcriptional and phenotypic identity. Therefore "transfer A, recover something with B's phenotype" demonstrates niche PERMISSIVENESS, not steady-state ontogeny. Two direct applications: the gd0.5-to-gd10.5 uterus is a rapidly expanding, largely unfilled niche, so donor filling and local phenotypic imprinting is the expected outcome under BOTH the conversion model and the precursor-recruitment model; and in TGF-betaRII-Ncr1-delta dams the accumulation of uterine cNK alongside loss of trNK is exactly what an unfilled/unretained niche looks like. BOTTOM LINE FROM THE HOME FIELDS: the assays that settled this question elsewhere are inducible genetic fate mapping (Sell/Eomes-CreERT2, KLRG1-CreERT2, Cx3cr1-CreERT2), single-cell barcoding, photoconversion, and intravascular labelling of the tracked cells. Barahona used none of them on the donor population. Every field that relied on bulk transfer plus marker phenotype was later corrected, in the same direction: what looked like conversion was selection of a pre-existing subset, or seeding of a precursor into an empty niche.
primary_source_citation: Barahona JD, Yang L, Nelson DM, Yokoyama WM. species: Human (Keskin 2007 and Cerdeira 2013: human peripheral blood NK from healthy donors / discarded leukopacks; human first-trimester decidua, 6-12 weeks gestation, elective terminations). The only IN VIVO evidence bearing on this claim is in a different species (mouse: Chantakru 2002; Barahona/Yokoyama eLife 2026) or in human transplant recipients (Strunz 2021; Strunz 2026) - see counter_evidence and audit_overturns_detail.
what_was_measured: In human, peripheral-blood NK cells negatively enriched with RosetteSep from healthy donors (and, in the key experiments, FACS-sorted into CD56+CD16+ and CD56+CD16- fractions that were CD9-negative and CD103-negative at day 0) were cultured in vitro for 2-3 weeks at 1e6 cells/ml in Myelocult + 10% human serum + 5% FCS with a constant background of 20 ng/ml IL-15 + 20 ng/ml SCF, either alone (control), or with 2 or 10 ng/ml recombinant TGF-beta1, or in conditioned medium from cultured first-trimester decidual stromal cells; at the 2-3 week endpoint the readout was surface staining by flow cytometry for CD56, CD16, CD9, CD103 (alphaE integrin) and pooled anti-KIR mAb (HP3-E4 + CH-L + DX9), scored as percentage of cells in each gate, in 15-16 independent donor cultures. Supporting arms: TGF-beta1 protein in decidual stromal conditioned medium by ELISA (81-419 pg/ml) across 17 CM preparations; blockade with pan-TGF-beta1/2/3 mAb 1D11 vs isotype; and, separately, decidual Lin-CD34+CD45+ cells sorted from decidua (250-500 cells/well) cultured ~30 days in the same CM + IL-15 + SCF and scored for CD56/CD16/CD9/CD94 in 4 experiments. In Cerdeira 2013 the analogous readout was, in human, pNK cultured 7 days at 1% O2 vs 21% O2 with 10 ng/ml IL-15 +/- 2 ng/ml TGF-beta1 +/- 1 uM 5-aza-2'-deoxycytidine, with day-7 flow cytometry for CD9/CD49a/KIR/chemokine receptors gated separately on CD56bright-CD16- and CD56dim-CD16+ events, VEGF-A ELISA, 4h 51Cr release on K562, HUVEC tube formation, and HTR-8/SVneo Matrigel invasion (n=10 blood donors for the invasion endpoint). No timepoint in either paper is an in vivo timepoint; no decidua was ever entered by a labelled blood NK cell in either paper.
n: Keskin 2007 (primary): 16 independent pNK cultures for the CD56+CD16- shift with decidual stromal CM (effect seen in 12/16, paired t-test p=0.002, SI Table 1); 15 independent experiments for the KIR readout; 17 CM preparations for the TGF-beta1 ELISA (and n=7 and n=8 for the +/- MPA/estradiol ELISA arms); 4 experiments for decidual Lin-CD34+CD45+ progenitor differentiation (dNK-like output in 3/4). The number of distinct blood donors and the number of distinct decidua donors are NEVER stated anywhere in the paper - "independent experiments" is the only unit reported, and each figure panel is labelled "representative". Cerdeira 2013: CD9 induction "representative of 10 experiments" (effect in 7/10 for the hypoxia-enhanced MFI), KIR "representative of 5 experiments"; VEGF-A n=3-4 experiments; HUVEC tube formation n=6; cytotoxicity n=2-3; trophoblast invasion N=10 donors (the only place a donor count is given); dNK IL-8 n=4 samples. NOT donors - donor counts are unreported in the primary source. NOT cells. controls: Keskin 2007 - PRESENT: paired same-donor medium-only arm (IL-15 + SCF, no TGF-beta1/no CM) run alongside every treated culture, with paired t-test; day-0 baseline staining establishing that input cells were CD9-negative, CD103-negative and only ~3% CD16-negative; isotype-control mAb histograms for CD9, CD103 and KIR; post-sort purity plots for the CD16+ vs CD16- fractions (Fig 5C); a genuine specificity control in the form of pan-TGF-beta1/2/3 neutralising mAb 1D11 (10 ug/ml) vs isotype pre-treatment of the conditioned medium, which abolished both the CD16 loss and the CD9 gain; decidual stromal preparations verified CD14-negative and CD45-negative before CM harvest; sorted KIR- pNK tested and shown NOT to acquire KIR (data not shown). ABSENT AND DECISIVE: no proliferation/division tracking (no CFSE, no Ki67, no cell counts per gate), so a gain in the PERCENTAGE of CD16-CD9+ cells cannot be separated from differential proliferation or differential death; no clonal barcoding, no genetic lineage tracing, no live imaging of a single cell losing CD16 and gaining CD9; no rigorous quantification of post-sort CD16- contamination in the critical CD16+ sorted arm; no in vivo arm of any kind. Cerdeira 2013 - PRESENT: paired same-donor 21% O2 control for every 1% O2 culture, Aza and TGF-beta1 dose-response, isotype controls, FACS-sorted 99%-pure CD56bright-CD16- and CD56dim-CD16+ subsets for the VEGF-A endpoint, HIF-1alpha immunoblot as a hypoxia-exposure control, and a striking reverse control (ex vivo dNK cells lose KIR and regain K562 cytotoxicity within 7-10 days of culture). ABSENT: the central phenotype experiments start from BULK enriched pNK, not from sorted CD56dim-CD16+ cells, and are then gated on the CD56bright-CD16- fraction - so the "converted" cells are read out inside a gate that the paper's own Fig 2a-2b shows is ENRICHED by the treatment; again no division tracking or barcoding.
strongest_alternative_explanation: A PRE-EXISTING SUBSET IS SELECTED / DIFFERENTIALLY EXPANDED, NOT CONVERTED - and the primary source itself supplies the ammunition. Keskin's own control arm states that IL-15 + SCF alone already increases the CD56+CD16- percentage, and the authors attribute this to "a greater proliferation of CD16- pNK cells, which are known to respond to these cytokines with greater proliferation, compared with CD16+ pNK cells". Over 2-3 weeks in IL-15/SCF, a 1-2% CD16- contaminant surviving the CD16+ sort needs only a modest proliferative advantage to dominate the well; TGF-beta1 is independently anti-proliferative for CD56dim NK, which would widen that advantage without any cell changing identity. Because the readout is percentage-in-gate by flow cytometry with no CFSE, no absolute counts, no Ki67 and no barcode, the assay is formally incapable of distinguishing conversion from selective outgrowth. Cerdeira 2013 makes this explicit in its own words for its own system - "Cultures under hypoxia were enriched in CD56Bright CD16- NK cells relative to cultures under 21% O2" and "hypoxia ... enriches pNK cell cultures in CD56Bright CD16- cells" - and then reads CD9/KIR out inside that enriched gate, starting from bulk pNK rather than sorted CD56dim cells. SECOND ALTERNATIVE - the endpoint markers are a generic TGF-beta / tissue-residency imprint, not decidual identity: CD9, CD103 and CD49a are TGF-beta-induced on NK cells in any tissue, and Keskin concedes in the Discussion that "the changes observed may not be specific to the decidual tissue but may occur when NK cells enter any tissue expressing TGF-beta"; CD9 is also inducible by IL-2/PHA. So "dNK-like" may name a cytokine signature, not a lineage destination. THIRD - TWO INDEPENDENT ORIGINS, again from inside the primary source: Keskin Fig 6 shows decidual Lin-CD34+CD45+ HPC generating CD56superbright CD16- CD9+ CD94+ cells in 3/4 experiments, i.e. the same paper offers a local-precursor route that does not pass through pbNK at all, and the authors' own summary is that "CD16+ pNK cells or decidual HPC, or both, are possible precursors". FOURTH - CULTURE ARTEFACT with demonstrated bidirectionality: Cerdeira Fig 1 shows ex vivo dNK cells LOSING KIR and REGAINING cytotoxicity within 7-10 days of the same IL-15 medium, so these markers are labile culture readouts that move in whichever direction the medium pushes; a marker that reverses in a week is weak evidence of a lineage transition.
counter_evidence: [audit] FOUND, on both sides. AGAINST the pbNK-origin claim (local / pre-existing precursor): (1) Vacca P et al., PNAS 2011;108(6):2402-7, PMID 21248224 - CD34+ hematopoietic precursors are present in human decidua, differ from cord- and peripheral-blood CD34+ cells, are already NK-committed (CD122+ CD127+, E4BP4/ID2 mRNA), and differentiate into CD56bright CD16- KIR+/- IL-8/IL-22-producing NK cells upon coculture with decidual stromal cells - a local origin bypassing pbNK entirely. (2) Male V, Hughes T, McClory S, Colucci F, Caligiuri MA, Moffett A, J Immunol 2010;185:3913-18, PMID 20802153 - stage-3 CD34-CD117+CD94- NK precursors are resident in human uterine mucosa and give rise to stage-4-like cells in vitro; the authors propose recruitment of an IMMATURE precursor, not of a mature pbNK. (3) Keskin 2007's own Fig 6: decidual Lin-CD34+CD45+ HPC generate CD56superbright CD16- CD9+ CD94+ cells in 3/4 experiments. crossfield_g4_findings: G4 VIOLATION IN THE AUDITED ROW: all 21 searches it lists are NK/decidua-internal. It ran ZERO searches in the TRM, ILC or myeloid literature on the same process (circulating cell -> tissue-resident cell; TGF-beta-driven residency programming). I ran them; findings below, each from a paper I located and whose abstract/methods I read. (A) MYELOID - THE STRONGEST PRIOR AGAINST READING KESKIN AS ONTOGENY. Yona S et al., Immunity 2013, PMID 23273845 ("Fate mapping reveals origins and dynamics of monocytes and tissue macrophages under homeostasis") and Hashimoto D et al., Immunity 2013, PMID 23601688 ("Tissue-resident macrophages self-maintain locally throughout adult life with minimal contribution from circulating monocytes"), with Guilliams M et al. 2013, PMID 24043763 (alveolar macrophages from fetal monocytes). For roughly forty years "blood monocyte becomes tissue macrophage" was textbook, and it rested on EXACTLY the evidence class Keskin supplies: a circulating cell cultured in tissue-conditioned medium acquires the tissue cell's markers, plus phenotypic similarity between the blood cell and the tissue cell. Genuine fate mapping (Cx3cr1-CreER, Flt3-Cre, parabiosis) overturned it - most tissue macrophages are embryonically seeded and locally self-renewing. The in vitro differentiation assay was reproducible and was a correct statement about what the cell CAN do; it was a false statement about what the cell DOES do in vivo. That is precisely the inferential gap between Keskin's culture and claim T3, and it is the reason INF_INVITRO must not drift upward. The same field also supplies the anti-overgeneralisation control: Bain CC et al., Nat Immunol 2014, PMID 25151491, shows intestinal macrophages ARE constantly monocyte-replenished - so the answer is organ-specific and a mouse-uterus result cannot be exported to human decidua. (B) TRM - THE MARKERS KESKIN SCORES ARE A GENERIC TGF-BETA RESIDENCY PROGRAM. Mackay LK et al., Nat Immunol 2013, PMID 24162776 ("The developmental pathway for CD103+CD8+ tissue-resident memory T cells of skin") and Zhang N & Bevan MJ, Immunity 2013, PMID 24076049 ("TGF-beta signaling controls the formation and maintenance of gut-resident memory T cells by regulating migration and retention"). TGF-beta-driven induction of CD103 (alphaE integrin) on a circulating lymphocyte entering any tissue is the canonical, organ-nonspecific residency program - the same cytokine and the same integrin Keskin reports, in a completely different lineage and a completely different organ. This independently confirms the audited row's second alternative (CD9/CD103/CD49a = generic TGF-beta imprint, not decidual identity) and matches Keskin's own Discussion concession that "the changes observed may not be specific to the decidual tissue but may occur when NK cells enter any tissue expressing TGFbeta". Zhang & Bevan's title carries the sharper methodological lesson: TGF-beta controls MIGRATION AND RETENTION. Therefore a TGF-beta-dependent change in the number of resident-phenotype cells is NOT evidence of conversion, because retention and conversion are confounded by the same signal. This directly undercuts the Barahona 2026 Tgfbr2-Ncr1-iCre arm, whose own authors concede "a defect in tissue retention rather than recruitment" - the knockout phenotype is exactly what a pure retention defect predicts, with no conversion step required. (C) TRM CLONALITY - THE EXPERIMENT THE dNK FIELD HAS NEVER RUN. Gaide O et al., Nat Med 2015;21:647-653, PMID 25962122 ("Common clonal origin of central and resident memory T cells following skin immunization"): high-throughput sequencing of TCRbeta CDR3 tracked thousands of unique clones at once, and for every abundant skin TRM clone an identical-TCR TCM clone was present in the lymph node. That is how the T cell field promoted "circulating becomes resident" from marker similarity to a clonal statement. NK cells have no rearranged receptor, so this exact trick is unavailable - but the equivalents exist and none has been applied to human pbNK -> dNK: KIR/HLA allotype tracking, mtDNA or somatic-SNP single-cell lineage tracing, or transposon/LARRY barcoding. This is the concrete missing experiment for T3, and its absence is why the claim cannot rise above INF_INVITRO. (D) ILC - THE MOST DIRECTLY TRANSFERABLE RESULT, AND IT FAVOURS LOCAL MAINTENANCE. Gasteiger G, Fan X, Dikiy S, Lee SY, Rudensky AY, Science 2015;350(6263):981-985, PMID 26472762 ("Tissue residency of innate lymphoid cells in lymphoid and nonlymphoid organs"): by parabiosis, ILCs in adult mice are tissue-resident cells "maintained and expanded locally" under physiologic conditions, under systemic perturbation of immune homeostasis, AND during acute helminth infection; only at LATE timepoints after infection did "cells from hematogenous sources help to partially replenish the pool of resident ILCs". Applied to T3: for the ILC family the default is local self-renewal, with blood-derived replenishment a slow, perturbation-dependent, PARTIAL minority contribution. The massive dNK expansion of early pregnancy is therefore more parsimoniously explained by local proliferation of a resident or local-precursor pool than by mass conversion of mature pbNK. Note that this same paper cites Sojka 2014 - and its "late timepoints only, partial" finding predicts the Sojka-2014-versus-Tatematsu-2025 discrepancy exactly: short parabiosis reads out residency, long and hormone-driven parabiosis reads out replenishment. Neither reading licenses "mature pbNK converts to dNK". (E) SHARED METHODOLOGICAL CONTROL THE HUMAN WORK LACKS. Anderson KG, Mayer-Barber K, Sung H, et al., Nat Protoc 2014;9:209-222, PMID 24385150 ("Intravascular staining for discrimination of vascular and tissue leukocytes") - the field-standard control against scoring a cell sitting in the tissue vasculature as tissue-resident. Barahona 2026 used it (3 ug anti-CD45.2-PE-Cy7 i.v., 3 min before euthanasia) and Tatematsu/Sojka 2025 used it. NO human study bearing on pbNK -> dNK has any equivalent, and human first-trimester decidua from elective terminations is blood-contaminated by construction - the same confound Keskin concedes for his decidual CD34+ arm. Any future human chimerism claim (uterus transplant, HSCT) that lacks an intravascular-labelling or equivalent perfusion control should be discounted on this basis.

Characterized by high expression of NK1.1, CD49a, and CD103, these cells share a gene-expression signature distinct from those of conventional NK cells ... Generation of these lymphocytes is dependent on the cytokine IL-15, but NOT the transcription factor Nfil3 THAT IS REQUIRED FOR THE DIFFERENTIATION OF TUMOR-INFILTRATING NK CELLS, and IL-15 deficiency, but not Nfil3 deficiency, results in accelerated tumor growth."
